nodes.description: This policy setting determines whether BitLocker protection is required for fixed data drives to be writable on a computer.

nodes.description: This policy setting controls the use of BitLocker on removable data drives. This policy setting is applied when you turn on BitLocker.

nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure the encryption type used by BitLocker Drive Encryption. This policy setting is applied when you turn on BitLocker.

nodes.name: RemovableDrivesExcludedFromEncryption
nodes.description: When enabled, allows you to exclude removable drives and devices connected over USB interface from BitLocker Device Encryption. Excluded devices cannot be encrypted, even manually.

nodes.name: RemovableDrivesRequireEncryption
nodes.description: This policy setting configures whether BitLocker protection is required for a computer to be able to write data to a removable data drive.

nodes.name: RequireDeviceEncryption
nodes.description: Allows the Admin to require encryption to be turned on using BitLocker\Device Encryption. The format is integer.

allowedValues.description: Disable. If the policy setting is not set or is set to 0, the device's enforcement status is not checked. The policy does not enforce encryption and it does not decrypt encrypted volumes.
Enable. The device's enforcement status is checked. Setting this policy to 1 triggers encryption of all drives (silently or non-silently based on AllowWarningForOtherDiskEncryption policy).

nodes.name: RequireStorageCardEncryption
nodes.description: Allows the Admin to require storage card encryption on the device. The format is integer.

allowedValues.description: Storage cards do not need to be encrypted.

nodes.name: MY/User/{CertHash}/IssuedBy

nodes.name: MY/User/{CertHash}/IssuedTo

nodes.name: MY/User/{CertHash}/ValidFrom
nodes.description: The starting date of the certificate's validity. This node is implicitly created only when the EncodedCertificate node is added.

nodes.name: MY/User/{CertHash}/ValidTo

nodes.name: MY/WSTEP

nodes.name: MY/WSTEP/CertThumprint

nodes.name: MY/WSTEP/Renew
nodes.description: The parent node to group renewal related settings.

nodes.name: MY/WSTEP/Renew/ErrorCode
nodes.description: If certificate renew fails, this node provide the last hresult code during renew process.

nodes.name: MY/WSTEP/Renew/LastRenewalAttemptTime
nodes.description: Time of last attempted renew

nodes.name: MY/WSTEP/Renew/ROBOSupport
nodes.description: Optional. Notify the client whether enrollment server supports ROBO auto certificate renew. NOTE: This flag is only needed to the device which is MDM enrolled via On-premise authentication method.

nodes.name: MY/WSTEP/Renew/RenewNow
nodes.description: Initiate a renew now

nodes.name: MY/WSTEP/Renew/RenewPeriod
nodes.description: Specify the number of days prior to the enrollment cert expiration to prompt the user to renew.

nodes.name: MY/WSTEP/Renew/RetryAfterExpiryInterval
nodes.description: How long after the enrollment cert has expiried to keep trying to renew

nodes.name: MY/WSTEP/Renew/RetryInterval
nodes.description: Optional. This parameter specifies retry interval when previous renew failed (in days). It applies to both manual cert renewal and ROBO cert renewal. Retry schedule will stop at cert expiration date.

nodes.name: MY/WSTEP/Renew/ServerURL
nodes.description: Optional. Specifies the cert renewal server URL which is the discovery server.

nodes.name: MY/WSTEP/Renew/Status
nodes.description: Show the latest action status for this certificate. Supported values are one of the following: 0 – Not started. 1 – Renewal in progress. 2 – Renewal succeeded. 3 – Renewal failed.

nodes.name: PFXCertInstall
nodes.description: Required for PFX certificate installation. The parent node grouping the PFX cert related settings.

nodes.name: PFXCertInstall/{UniqueID}
nodes.description: Required for PFX certificate installation. A unique ID to differentiate different certificate install requests. Format is node.

nodes.name: PFXCertInstall/{UniqueID}/ContainerName
nodes.description: Optional. Specifies the NGC container name (if NGC KSP is chosen for above node). If this node is not specified when NGC KSP is chosen, enrollment will fail.

nodes.name: PFXCertInstall/{UniqueID}/KeyLocation
nodes.description: Required for PFX certificate installation. Indicates the KeyStorage provider to target the private key installation to.

allowedValues.description: Install to TPM if present, fail if not present.
Install to TPM if present. If not present, fallback to software.
Install to Windows Hello for Business (formerly known as Microsoft Passport for Work) whose name is specified

nodes.name: PFXCertInstall/{UniqueID}/PFXCertBlob
nodes.description: Required. CRYPT_DATA_BLOB structure that contains a PFX packet with the exported and encrypted certificates and keys. Add on this node will trigger the addition to the PFX certificate.

nodes.name: PFXCertInstall/{UniqueID}/PFXCertPassword
nodes.description: Password that protects the PFX blob. This is required if the PFX is password protected.

nodes.name: PFXCertInstall/{UniqueID}/PFXCertPasswordEncryptionStore
nodes.description: Optional. When a value of "2" is contained iin PFXCertPasswordEncryptionType, specify the store name where the certificate for decrypting the PFXCertPassword is stored.

nodes.name: PFXCertInstall/{UniqueID}/PFXCertPasswordEncryptionType
nodes.description: Optional. Used to specify if the PFX certificate password is encrypted with a certificate.

allowedValues.description: Password is encrypted with the MDM certificate.
Password is encrypted with custom certificate.

nodes.name: PFXCertInstall/{UniqueID}/PFXKeyExportable
nodes.description: Optional. Used to specify if the private key installed is exportable (can be exported later).

nodes.name: PFXCertInstall/{UniqueID}/Status
nodes.description: Returns the error code of the PFX installation from the GetLastError command called after the PfxImportCertStore.

nodes.name: PFXCertInstall/{UniqueID}/Thumbprint
nodes.description: Returns the thumbprint of the PFX certificate installed.

nodes.name: SCEP
nodes.description: Node for SCEP. An alert is sent after the SCEP certificate is installed.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}
nodes.description: Required for SCEP certificate installation. A unique ID to differentiate different certificate install requests. Calling Delete on the this node, should delete the corresponding SCEP certificate

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/CertThumbprint
nodes.description: Optional. Specify the current cert’s thumbprint if certificate enrollment succeeds. It is a 20-byte value of the SHA1 certificate hash specified as a hexadecimal string value.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/ErrorCode
nodes.description: Optional. The integer value that indicates the HRESULT of the last enrollment error code.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install
nodes.description: Required for SCEP certificate enrollment. Parent node to group SCEP cert install related request.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install/AADKeyIdentifierList
nodes.description: Optional. Specify the AAD Key Identifier List as a semicolon separated values. On Enroll, the values in this list are validated against the AAD Key present on the device.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install/AttestPrivateKey
nodes.description: Defines the attest SCEP private key behavior 0 - normal, 1 - best effort, 2 - on error, fail the installation

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install/CAThumbprint
nodes.description: Required. Specify root CA thumbprint. It is a 20-byte value of the SHA1 certificate hash specified as a hexadecimal string value.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install/Challenge
nodes.description: Required for SCEP certificate enrollment. B64 encoded SCEP enrollment challenge. Challenge will be deleted shortly after the Exec command is accepted.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install/ContainerName
nodes.description: Optional. Specifies the NGC container name (if NGC KSP is chosen for above node). If this node is not specified when NGC KSP is chosen, enrollment will fail.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install/CustomTextToShowInPrompt
nodes.description: Optional. Specifies the custom text to show on the NGC PIN prompt during certificate enrollment.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install/EKUMapping
nodes.description: Required. Specify extended key usages. Subjected to SCEP server configuration. The list of OIDs are separated by plus “+”. Sample format: OID1+OID2+OID3.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install/Enroll
nodes.description: Required. Trigger the device to start the cert enrollment. The device will not notify MDM server after cert enrollment is done.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install/HashAlgorithm
nodes.description: Required for enrollment. Hash algorithm family (SHA-1, SHA-2, SHA-3) specified by MDM server.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install/KeyLength
nodes.description: Required for enrollment. Specify private key length (RSA). Valid value: 1024, 2048, 4096. For NGC, only 2048 is the supported keylength.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install/KeyProtection
nodes.description: Optional. Specify where to keep the private key. Note that even it is protected by TPM, it is not guarded with TPM PIN. SCEP enrolled cert doesn’t support TPM PIN protection.

allowedValues.description: Private key protected by phone TPM if the device supports TPM. All Windows Phone 8.1 devices support TPM and will treat value 2 as 1.
(Default) Private key saved in software KSP.
Private key protected by Windows Hello for Business (formerly known as Microsoft Passport for Work). If this option is specified, the ContainerName must be specified, otherwise enrollment will fail.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install/KeyUsage
nodes.description: Required for enrollment. Specify the key usage bits (0x80, 0x20, 0xA0, etc.) for the certificate in decimal format. The value should at least have second (0x20) or forth (0x80) or both bits set.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install/RetryCount
nodes.description: Optional. Special to SCEP. Specify device retry times when the SCEP sever sends pending status. Format is int. Default value is 3. Max value: the value cannot be larger than 30.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install/RetryDelay
nodes.description: Optional. When the SCEP server sends pending status, specify device retry waiting time in minutes. Default value is: 5 The min value is 1.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install/ServerURL
nodes.description: Required for SCEP certificate enrollment. Specify the cert enrollment server. The server could specify multiple server URLs separated by semicolon.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install/SubjectAlternativeNames
nodes.description: Optional. Specify subject alternative name. Multiple alternative names could be specified by this node. Each name is the combination of name format+actual name.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install/SubjectName
nodes.description: Required. Specify the subject name. The SubjectName value is quoted if it contains leading or trailing white space or one of the following characters: (“,” “=” “+” “;” ).

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install/TemplateName
nodes.description: Optional. OID of certificate template name. Note that this name is typically ignored by the SCEP server, therefore the MDM server typically doesn’t need to provide it.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install/ValidPeriod
nodes.description: Optional. Specify the units for valid period. Valid values are: Days(Default), Months, Years.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Install/ValidPeriodUnits
nodes.description: Optional. Specify desired number of units used in validity period. Subjected to SCEP server configuration. Default is 0. The units are defined in ValidPeriod node.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/RespondentServerUrl
nodes.description: Required. Returns the URL of the SCEP server that responded to the enrollment request.

nodes.name: SCEP/{UniqueID}/Status
nodes.description: Required. Specify the latest status for the certificate due to enroll request.

nodes.name: CloudDesktop
nodes.description: The CloudDesktop configuration service provider is used to configure different Cloud PC related scenarios.

nodes.name: BootToCloudPCEnhanced
nodes.description: This node allows to configure different kinds of Boot to Cloud mode.

allowedValues.description: Enable Boot to Cloud Shared PC Mode
Enable Boot to Cloud Dedicated Mode (Cloud only)

nodes.name: EnableBootToCloudSharedPCMode
nodes.description: Setting this node to "true" configures boot to cloud for Shared PC mode.

allowedValues.description: Boot to cloud shared pc mode enabled

nodes.name: CloudDesktop
nodes.description: The CloudDesktop configuration service provider is used to configure different Cloud PC related scenarios.

nodes.name: EnablePhysicalDeviceAccessOnCtrlAltDel
nodes.description: Configuring this node gives access to the physical devices used to boot to Cloud PCs from the Ctrl+Alt+Del page for specified users. This node supports these options: 0. Not enabled 1. Enabled.

allowedValues.description: Access to physical device on CtrlAltDel page disabled
Access to physical device on CtrlAltDel page enabled

nodes.name: EnablePhysicalDeviceAccessOnErrorScreens
nodes.description: Configuring this node gives access to the physical devices used to boot to Cloud PCs from the error screens for specified users. This node supports these options: 0. Not enabled 1. Enabled.

allowedValues.description: Access to physical device on error screens disabled
Access to physical device on error screens enabled

nodes.name: BackgroundTasksToLaunch
nodes.description: List of package names of background tasks that needs to be launched on boot.

nodes.name: BackgroundTasksToLaunch/{BackgroundTaskPackageName}
nodes.description: Package Full Name of the App that needs be launched in the background. This can contain no entry points, a single or multiple entry points

nodes.name: StartupAppID
nodes.description: AppID string value is the default appid/AUMID to launch during boot up

nodes.name: DMAcc
nodes.description: This interior node is a common parent to all OMA DM server account nodes that use OMA DM 1.2 protocol.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}
nodes.description: This interior node acts as a placeholder for zero or more OMA DM server accounts.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/AAuthPref
nodes.description: Specifies the application authentication preference.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/AppAddr
nodes.description: Interior node for DM server address.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/AppAddr/{ObjectName}
nodes.description: Defines the OMA DM server address. Only one server address can be configured.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/AppAddr/{ObjectName}/Addr
nodes.description: Specifies the address of the OMA DM account. The type of address stored is specified by the AddrType element.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/AppAddr/{ObjectName}/AddrType
nodes.description: Specifies the format and interpretation of the Addr node value. The default is "URI". The default value of "URI" specifies that the OMA DM account address in Addr is a URI address.

allowedValues.description: The OMA DM account address in Addr is a URI address.
The OMA DM account address in Addr is an IP address.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/AppAddr/{ObjectName}/Port
nodes.description: Interior node for port information.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/AppAddr/{ObjectName}/Port/{ObjectName}
nodes.description: Only one port number can be configured. When mapping the w7 APPLICATION configuration service provider to the DMAcc Configuration Service Provider, the name of this element is "1".

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/AppAddr/{ObjectName}/Port/{ObjectName}/PortNbr
nodes.description: Specifies the port number of the OMA MD account address. This must be a decimal number that fits within the range of a 16-bit unsigned integer.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/AppAuth
nodes.description: Defines authentication settings.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/AppAuth/{ObjectName}
nodes.description: Defines one set of authentication settings.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/AppAuth/{ObjectName}/AAuthData
nodes.description: Specifies the next nonce used for authentication. "Nonce" refers to a number used once.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/AppAuth/{ObjectName}/AAuthLevel
nodes.description: Specifies the application authentication level. A value of "CLCRED" indicates that the credentials client will authenticate itself to the OMA DM server at the OMA DM protocol level.

allowedValues.description: The credentials client will authenticate itself to the OMA DM server at the OMA DM protocol level.
The credentials server will authenticate itself to the OMA DM Client at the OMA DM protocol level.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/AppAuth/{ObjectName}/AAuthName
nodes.description: Specifies the authentication name.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/AppAuth/{ObjectName}/AAuthSecret
nodes.description: Specifies the password or secret used for authentication.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/AppAuth/{ObjectName}/AAuthType
nodes.description: Specifies the authentication type. If AAuthLevel is CLCRED, the supported types include BASIC and DIGEST. If AAuthLevel is SRVCRED, the only supported type is DIGEST.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/AppID
nodes.description: Specifies the application identifier for the OMA DM account.. The only supported value is w7.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/Ext
nodes.description: Defines a set of extended parameters. This element holds vendor-specific information about the OMA DM account and is created automatically when the OMA DM account is created.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/Ext/Microsoft
nodes.description: Defines a set of Microsoft-specific extended parameters. This element is created automatically when the OMA DM account is created.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/Ext/Microsoft/BackCompatRetryDisabled
nodes.description: This node specifies whether to disable the ability of the DM client to communicate with a down-level server.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/Ext/Microsoft/CRLCheck
nodes.description: Allows connection to the DM server to check the Certificate Revocation List (CRL). Set to true to enable SSL revocation.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/Ext/Microsoft/ConnRetryFreq
nodes.description: This node specifies how many times DM client will retry a connection to the server if the connection fails. The default value is 3 retries.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/Ext/Microsoft/DefaultEncoding
nodes.description: This node specifies the encoding that the OMA-DM client will use to encode its first package.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/Ext/Microsoft/DisableOnRoaming
nodes.description: Determines whether the OMA DM client should be launched when roaming.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/Ext/Microsoft/InitialBackOffTime
nodes.description: This node specifies the initial amount of time (in milliseconds) that the DM client waits before attempting a connection retry. After the initial wait, the wait time grows exponentially.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/Ext/Microsoft/InitiateSession
nodes.description: When this node is added, a session is started with the MDM server.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/Ext/Microsoft/MaxBackOffTime
nodes.description: This node specifies the maximum number of milliseconds to wait before attempting a connection retry. The default value is 86400000.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/Ext/Microsoft/ProtoVer
nodes.description: This node value corresponds to what the client would put in the VerDTD element of an OMA-DM package. No default value is assumed. The only valid value for this node is 1.1 or 1.2.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/Ext/Microsoft/Role
nodes.description: If this node is unspecified, its default value is the access role of the session that created the server account.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/Ext/Microsoft/SSLCLIENTCERTSEARCHCRITERIA
nodes.description: The SSLCLIENTCERTSEARCHCRITERIA parameter is used to specify the client certificate search criteria. This parameter supports search by subject attribute and certificate stores.

nodes.name: {AccountUID}/Ext/Microsoft/UseHwDevID
nodes.description: A value of true indicates that, during an OMA-DM session with this server, the value of the ./DevInfo/DevId node is the hardware ID of device (e.g, IMEI for a GSM device, ESN for a CDMA Device,…

nodes.name: Configuration/DeploymentChannel
nodes.description: Enable this policy to specify when devices receive Microsoft Defender binary updates based on the chosen deployment channel rollout.

allowedValues.description: Not Configured (Default). If you don't configure this policy, devices are added to the release channel. Microsoft determines whether devices receive updates earlier or later within the release channel.

Validation Channel: Devices set to this channel are the first to receive new monthly binary (platform and engine) updates. The likelihood of new issues occurring is higher, so add only devices with the highest risk tolerance to this channel (recommended for 1% or less of devices in your environment).

Release Channel - Early: The release channel is appropriate for most of your production environment. Devices set to this channel are offered updates earliest in the release channel. Distribute devices across early, fast and broad depending on their risk tolerance. Add devices in the earlier channels to surface issues sooner and avoid impacting the rest of your environment.

Release Channel - Fast: The release channel is appropriate for most of your production environment. Devices are offered updates later during the gradual release cycle. Distribute devices across early, fast and broad depending on their risk tolerance. Use devices in the earlier channels to surface issues sooner and avoid impacting the rest of your environment.

Release Channel - Broad: The release channel is appropriate for most of your production environment. Devices in this channel receive updates at the end of the gradual release cycle. Distribute devices across early, fast and broad depending on their risk tolerance. Use devices in the earlier channels to surface issues sooner and avoid impacting the rest of your environment.

Delayed Channel: Devices in this channel are offered updates approximately 48 hours after the devices in the release channel (broad). Use this channel for critical infrastructure and high value assets (~1% or less of devices).

nodes.name: Configuration/EngineUpdatesChannel
nodes.description: [to be deprecated] Enable this policy to specify when devices receive Microsoft Defender engine updates during the monthly gradual rollout.

allowedValues.description: Not configured (Default). The device will stay up to date automatically during the gradual release cycle. Suitable for most devices.

Beta Channel: Devices set to this channel will be the first to receive new updates. Select Beta Channel to participate in identifying and reporting issues to Microsoft. Devices in the Windows Insider Program are subscribed to this channel by default. For use in (manual) test environments only and a limited number of devices.
Current Channel (Preview): Devices set to this channel will be offered updates earliest during the monthly gradual release cycle. Suggested for pre-production/validation environments.
Current Channel (Staged): Devices will be offered updates after the monthly gradual release cycle. Suggested to apply to a small, representative part of your production population (~10%).
Current Channel (Broad): Devices will be offered updates only after the gradual release cycle completes. Suggested to apply to a broad set of devices in your production population (~10-100%).
Critical - Time delay: Devices will be offered updates with a 48-hour delay. Suggested for critical environments only.

If you disable or do not configure this setting, local admins will be able to see exclusions in the Windows Security App and via PowerShell.

nodes.name: Configuration/HideExclusionsFromLocalUsers

allowedValues.description: If you enable this setting, local users will no longer be able to see the exclusion list in Windows Security App or via PowerShell.
If you disable or do not configure this setting, local users will be able to see exclusions in the Windows Security App and via PowerShell.

If you configure this setting to disabled, Intel TDT integration will turn off.

allowedValues.description: Not configured (Default). The device will stay up to date automatically during the gradual release cycle. Suitable for most devices.

Beta Channel: Devices set to this channel will be the first to receive new updates. Select Beta Channel to participate in identifying and reporting issues to Microsoft. Devices in the Windows Insider Program are subscribed to this channel by default. For use in (manual) test environments only and a limited number of devices.
Current Channel (Preview): Devices set to this channel will be offered updates earliest during the monthly gradual release cycle. Suggested for pre-production/validation environments.
Current Channel (Staged): Devices will be offered updates after the monthly gradual release cycle. Suggested to apply to a small, representative part of your production population (~10%).
Current Channel (Broad): Devices will be offered updates only after the gradual release cycle completes. Suggested to apply to a broad set of devices in your production population (~10-100%).
Critical - Time delay: Devices will be offered updates with a 48-hour delay. Suggested for critical environments only.

nodes.name: DeviceAssociation/DeviceLink/DeviceLinkInfoRequest/ErrorCode
nodes.description: Error value, if any, associated with Device Association tag request operation (typically an HRESULT).

nodes.name: DeviceAssociation/DeviceLink/DeviceLinkInfoRequest/ErrorPhase
nodes.description: This node provides the specific phase that failed during the GenerateDeviceLinkInfo action.

nodes.name: DeviceAssociation/DeviceLink/DeviceLinkInfoRequest/GenerateDeviceLinkInfo
nodes.description: Any pre-existing DeviceLinkInfo must first be cleared before invoking this action.

nodes.name: DeviceAssociation/DeviceLink/DeviceLinkInfoRequest/Status
nodes.description: Status value associated with Device Association tag request operation.

nodes.name: DeviceAssociation/TenantAssociation
nodes.description: Settings for associating the device to a tenant.

nodes.name: DeviceAssociation/TenantAssociation/TenantAssociationInfo
nodes.description: The current tenant association data. To clear this node, Replace is used, passing in null data.

nodes.name: DeviceAssociation/TenantAssociation/TenantAssociationInfoRequest/ErrorCode
nodes.description: Error value, if any, associated with Device Association tag request operation (typically an HRESULT).

nodes.name: DeviceAssociation/TenantAssociation/TenantAssociationInfoRequest/ErrorPhase
nodes.description: This node provides the specific phase that failed during the RefreshTenantAssociation action.

nodes.name: DeviceAssociation/TenantAssociation/TenantAssociationInfoRequest/RefreshTenantAssociationInfo
nodes.description: Any pre-existing tenant association info will be automatically overwritten when this action is completed successfully.

nodes.name: DeviceAssociation/TenantAssociation/TenantAssociationInfoRequest/Status
nodes.description: Status value associated with Device Association tag request operation.

nodes.name: IsPostOobeProvisioningAllowed
nodes.description: This node determines whether Autopilot Device Preparation provisioning can be executed after OOBE has completed.

allowedValues.description: Autopilot Device Preparation provisioning is only allowed during OOBE.
Autopilot Device Preparation provisioning is only allowed post-OOBE.

nodes.name: MDMProvider
nodes.description: Parent node for configuring the MDM provider that interacts with the BootstrapperAgent.

nodes.name: MDMProvider/MdmAgentInstalled
nodes.description: This node indicates whether the mdm agent was installed or not. When set to true sets the AUTOPILOT_MDM_AGENT_REGISTERED WNF event.

nodes.name: MDMProvider/Progress
nodes.description: Node for reporting progress status as opaque data. Contract for data is between the server and EMM agent that reads the data.

nodes.name: MDMProvider/RebootRequired
nodes.description: This node indicates whether an MDM policy was provisioned that requires a reboot.

nodes.name: PageEnabled
nodes.description: This node determines whether to show the Device Preparation page during OOBE.

nodes.name: PageErrorCode
nodes.description: This node provides specific overall HRESULT causing a fatal error on the Device Preparation page. This node is valid only if the PageErrorPhase node's value is not Unknown.

nodes.name: PageErrorDetails
nodes.description: This node provides optional details for any fatal error on the Device Preparation page. This node is valid only if the PageErrorPhase node's value is not Unknown, but not all errors will have details.

nodes.name: PageErrorPhase
nodes.description: This node provides the specific phase that failed during the Device Preparation page. Values are an enum: 0 = Unknown; 1 = AgentDownload; 2 = AgentProgress.

nodes.name: PageSettings
nodes.description: This node configures the Device Preparation page settings.

nodes.name: PageStatus
nodes.description: This node provides status of the Device Preparation page.

nodes.name: Antispyware
nodes.description: Node for the antispyware query.

nodes.name: Antispyware/SignatureStatus
nodes.description: Integer that specifies the status of the antispyware signature.

nodes.name: Antispyware/Status
nodes.description: Integer that specifies the status of the antispyware.

nodes.name: Antivirus
nodes.description: Node for the antivirus query.

nodes.name: Antivirus/SignatureStatus
nodes.description: Integer that specifies the status of the antivirus signature.

nodes.name: Antivirus/Status
nodes.description: Integer that specifies the status of the antivirus.

nodes.name: Battery
nodes.description: Node for the battery query.

nodes.name: Battery/EstimatedChargeRemaining
nodes.description: Integer that specifies the estimated battery charge remaining. This is the value returned in BatteryLifeTime in SYSTEM_POWER_STATUS structure.

nodes.name: Battery/EstimatedRuntime
nodes.description: Integer that specifies the estimated runtime of the battery. This is the value returned in BatteryLifeTime in SYSTEM_POWER_STATUS structure.

nodes.name: Battery/Status
nodes.description: Integer that specifies the status of the battery

nodes.name: CellularIdentities
nodes.description: Node for queries on the SIM cards.

nodes.name: CellularIdentities/{IMEI}
nodes.description: The unique International Mobile Station Equipment Identity (IMEI) number of the mobile device. An IMEI is present for each SIM card on the device.

nodes.name: CellularIdentities/{IMEI}/CommercializationOperator
nodes.description: The mobile service provider or mobile operator associated with the specific IMEI number.

nodes.name: CellularIdentities/{IMEI}/ICCID
nodes.description: The Integrated Circuit Card ID (ICCID) of the SIM card associated with the specific IMEI number.

nodes.name: CellularIdentities/{IMEI}/IMSI
nodes.description: The International Mobile Subscriber Identity (IMSI) associated with the IMEI number.

nodes.name: CellularIdentities/{IMEI}/PhoneNumber
nodes.description: Phone number associated with the specific IMEI number.

nodes.name: CellularIdentities/{IMEI}/RoamingCompliance
nodes.description: Boolean value that indicates compliance with the enforced enterprise roaming policy.

nodes.name: CellularIdentities/{IMEI}/RoamingStatus
nodes.description: Indicates whether the SIM card associated with the specific IMEI number is roaming.

nodes.name: CertAttestation
nodes.description: Node for Certificate Attestation

nodes.name: CertAttestation/MDMClientCertAttestation
nodes.description: MDM Certificate attestation information. This will return an XML blob containing the relevent attestation fields.

nodes.name: Compliance
nodes.description: Node for the compliance query.

nodes.name: Compliance/EncryptionCompliance
nodes.description: Boolean value that indicates compliance with the enterprise encryption policy for OS (system) drives. The value is one of the following: 0 - not encrypted, 1 - encrypted

nodes.name: DMA
nodes.description: Node for DMA query.

nodes.name: DMA/BootDMAProtectionStatus
nodes.description: Boot DMA Protection status. 1 - Enabled, 2 - Disabled

nodes.name: DeviceGuard
nodes.description: Node for Device Guard query.

nodes.name: DeviceGuard/HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrityStatus
nodes.description: Hypervisor Enforced Code Integrity (HVCI) status. 0 - Running, 1 - Reboot required, 2 - Not configured, 3 - VBS not running

nodes.name: DeviceGuard/LsaCfgCredGuardStatus
nodes.description: Local System Authority (LSA) credential guard status. 0 - Running, 1 - Reboot required, 2 - Not licensed for Credential Guard, 3 - Not configured, 4 - VBS not running

nodes.name: DeviceGuard/SystemGuardStatus
nodes.description: System Guard status. 0 - Running, 1 - Reboot required, 2 - Not configured, 3 - System doesn't meet hardware requirements

nodes.name: DeviceGuard/VirtualizationBasedSecurityHwReq
nodes.description: Virtualization-based security hardware requirement status.

nodes.name: DeviceGuard/VirtualizationBasedSecurityStatus
nodes.description: Virtualization-based security status.

nodes.name: DomainName
nodes.description: Returns the fully qualified domain name of the device(if any).

nodes.name: Firewall
nodes.description: Node for the firewall query.

nodes.name: Firewall/Status
nodes.description: Integer that specifies the status of the firewall.

nodes.name: NetworkIdentifiers
nodes.description: Node for queries on network and device properties.

nodes.name: NetworkIdentifiers/{MacAddress}
nodes.description: MAC address of the wireless network card. A MAC address is present for each network card on the device.

nodes.name: NetworkIdentifiers/{MacAddress}/IPAddressV4
nodes.description: IPv4 address of the network card associated with the MAC address.

nodes.name: NetworkIdentifiers/{MacAddress}/IPAddressV6
nodes.description: IPv6 address of the network card associated with the MAC address.

nodes.name: NetworkIdentifiers/{MacAddress}/IsConnected
nodes.description: Boolean value that indicates whether the network card associated with the MAC address has an active network connection.

nodes.name: NetworkIdentifiers/{MacAddress}/Type
nodes.description: Type of network connection. The value is one of the following: 2 - WLAN (or other Wireless interface), 1 - LAN (or other Wired interface), 0 - Unknown

nodes.name: OS
nodes.description: Node for the OS query.

nodes.name: OS/Edition
nodes.description: String that specifies the OS edition.

nodes.name: OS/Mode
nodes.description: Read only node that specifies the device mode. Valid values: 0 - the device is in standard configuration, 1 - the device is in S mode configuration

nodes.name: SecureBoot/SecurebootCertificateUpdateError
nodes.description: Returns the first error encountered during Secure Boot certificate update (if any). This error corresponds to the event log error that was logged.

nodes.name: SecureBoot/SecurebootCertificateUpdateStatus
nodes.description: Returns the current state of the Secure Boot certificate updates on the device.

nodes.name: SecureBootState
nodes.description: Indicates whether secure boot is enabled. The value is one of the following: 0 - Not supported, 1 - Enabled, 2 - Disabled

nodes.name: TPM
nodes.description: Node for the TPM query.

nodes.name: TPM/ManufacturerId
nodes.description: String that specifies the TPM manufacturer ID as a number.

nodes.name: TPM/ManufacturerIdTxt
nodes.description: String that specifies the TPM manufacturer ID as text.

nodes.name: TPM/ManufacturerVersion
nodes.description: String that specifies the manufacturer version.

nodes.name: TPM/SpecificationVersion
nodes.description: String that specifies the specification version.

nodes.name: UAC
nodes.description: Node for the UAC query.

nodes.name: UAC/Status
nodes.description: Integer that specifies the status of the UAC.

nodes.name: DeviceStateData
nodes.description: Root node of all types of device state data that CSP exposes.

nodes.name: DeviceStateData/MdmConfiguration
nodes.description: This node is to trigger snapping of the Device Management state data with "SNAP".

nodes.name: DiagnosticArchive
nodes.description: Root note for archive definition and collection.

nodes.name: DiagnosticArchive/ArchiveResults
nodes.description: Pull up the results of the last archive run.

nodes.name: EtwLog
nodes.description: Root node of all types of event logging nodes that CSP manages.

nodes.name: EtwLog/Channels
nodes.description: Root node of registered "Channel" nodes.

nodes.name: EtwLog/Channels/{ChannelName}
nodes.description: Each dynamic node represents a registered 'Channel' node.

nodes.name: EtwLog/Channels/{ChannelName}/Export
nodes.description: This node is to trigger exporting events into a log file from this node's associated Windows event channel.

nodes.name: EtwLog/Channels/{ChannelName}/Filter
nodes.description: This node is used for setting or getting the xpath query string to filter the events when exporting the log file from the channel. Default value is empty string.

nodes.name: EtwLog/Channels/{ChannelName}/State
nodes.description: This node is used for setting or getting the 'Enabled' state of this node's associated windows event channel in the system.

nodes.name: EtwLog/Collectors
nodes.description: Root node of registered "Collector" nodes.

nodes.name: EtwLog/Collectors/{CollectorName}
nodes.description: Each dynamic node represents a registered 'Collector' node. CSP will maintain an ETW trace session for this collector with its name used as a unique identifier.

nodes.name: EtwLog/Collectors/{CollectorName}/LogFileSizeLimitMB
nodes.description: This node is used for setting or getting the trace log file size limit(in Megabytes) of this collector node's associated trace session. The value range is 1~2048. Default value is 4.

nodes.name: EtwLog/Collectors/{CollectorName}/Providers
nodes.description: Root node of all providers registered in this collector node.

nodes.name: EtwLog/Collectors/{CollectorName}/Providers/{ProviderGuid}
nodes.description: Each dynamic node represents an ETW provider registered in this collector node. The node name must be a valid provider GUID.

nodes.name: EtwLog/Collectors/{CollectorName}/Providers/{ProviderGuid}/Keywords
nodes.description: This node is used for setting or getting the keywords of the event provider in this collector node's associated trace session. The string is in the form of hexadecimal digits and 16 chars wide.

nodes.name: EtwLog/Collectors/{CollectorName}/Providers/{ProviderGuid}/State
nodes.description: This node is used for setting or getting the state of the event provider in this collector node's associated trace session.

allowedValues.description: Provider is enabled in the trace session. This is the default.
Provider is disabled in the trace session.

nodes.name: EtwLog/Collectors/{CollectorName}/Providers/{ProviderGuid}/TraceLevel
nodes.description: This node is used for setting or getting the trace level of this event provider in this collector node's associated trace session.

allowedValues.description: TRACE_LEVEL_CRITICAL - Abnormal exit or termination events
TRACE_LEVEL_WARNING - Warning events such as allocation failures
TRACE_LEVEL_INFORMATION - Non-error events, such as entry or exit events

nodes.name: EtwLog/Collectors/{CollectorName}/TraceControl
nodes.description: This node is to trigger "start" and "stop" of this collector node's associated trace session. "Get" returns the name of this node.

nodes.name: EtwLog/Collectors/{CollectorName}/TraceLogFileMode
nodes.description: This node is used for setting or getting the trace log file mode of this collector node's associated trace session.

allowedValues.description: EVENT_TRACE_FILE_MODE_SEQUENTIAL-Writes events to a log file sequentially. It stops when the file reaches its maximum size.
EVENT_TRACE_FILE_MODE_CIRCULAR-Writes events to a log file. After the file reaches the maximum size, the oldest events are replaced with incoming events.

nodes.name: EtwLog/Collectors/{CollectorName}/TraceStatus
nodes.description: This node is used for getting the status of this collector node's associated trace session. 1 means "in progress"; 0 means "not started or stopped".

nodes.name: FileDownload
nodes.description: Root node of all csp nodes that are related to log file download in csp.

nodes.name: FileDownload/DMChannel
nodes.description: Root node of all csp nodes that are used for controlling file download for their associated log file generated by logging csp nodes.

nodes.name: FileDownload/DMChannel/{FileContext}
nodes.description: Each dynamic node represents a 'FileContext' node corresponding to a log file generated by one of the logging CSP nodes(underneath 'EtwLog' node).

nodes.name: FileDownload/DMChannel/{FileContext}/BlockCount
nodes.description: This node is used for getting the total number of blocks for the associated log file.

nodes.name: FileDownload/DMChannel/{FileContext}/BlockData
nodes.description: This node is used to get the binary data of the block that 'BlockIndexToRead' node is pointing to.

nodes.name: FileDownload/DMChannel/{FileContext}/BlockIndexToRead
nodes.description: This node is used for setting and getting the block index that points to the data block for 'BlockData' node. The value range is 0~(BlockCount-1).

nodes.name: FileDownload/DMChannel/{FileContext}/BlockSizeKB
nodes.description: This node is used for setting or getting the block size (in Kilobytes) for the download of assoicated log file. The value range is 1~16. Default value is 4.

nodes.name: FileDownload/DMChannel/{FileContext}/DataBlocks
nodes.description: Root node of all 'BlockNumber' nodes for the associated log file. The number of its children should be the total block count of the log file.

nodes.name: FileDownload/DMChannel/{FileContext}/DataBlocks/{BlockNumber}
nodes.description: Each dynamic node represents a 'BlockNumber' node. The node name is an integer equal to the index of the block which this node stands for.

nodes.name: Policy
nodes.description: Contains policy for diagnostic settings.

nodes.name: Policy/Channels
nodes.description: Contains policy for Event Log channel settings.

nodes.name: Policy/Channels/{ChannelName}
nodes.description: Each dynamic node represents a registered 'Channel' node.

nodes.name: Policy/Channels/{ChannelName}/ActionWhenFull
nodes.description: Action to take when the log file reaches maximum size. "Truncate", "Overwrite", "Archive".

allowedValues.description: When the log file reaches its maximum file size, new events are not written to the log and are lost.
When the log file reaches its maximum file size, new events overwrite old events.

When the log file reaches its maximum size, the log file is saved to the location specified by the "Archive Location" policy setting. If archive location value is not set, the new file is saved in the same directory as current log file.

nodes.name: Policy/Channels/{ChannelName}/Enabled
nodes.description: This policy setting specifies whether the channel should be enabled or disabled. Set value to TRUE to enable and FALSE to disable.

nodes.name: Policy/Channels/{ChannelName}/MaximumFileSize
nodes.description: Maximum size of the channel log file in MB.

nodes.name: Policy/Channels/{ChannelName}/SDDL
nodes.description: SDDL String controlling access to the channel. Default: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/desktop/WES/eventmanifestschema-channeltype-complextype

nodes.name: ActiveList
nodes.description: A string containing the list of all active ContextIDs on the device. Delimeter is unicode character 0xF000.

nodes.name: AlertsEnabled
nodes.description: A Boolean value that sets if when a context fails, the CSP sends an alert to the Server

nodes.name: Contexts/{ContextID}
nodes.description: Node created by the server to define a context. Maximum amount of characters allowed is 38.

nodes.name: Contexts/{ContextID}/Altitude
nodes.description: A value that determines how to handle resolution of applying multiple contexts on the device. Required, and must be distinct of other priorities.

nodes.name: Contexts/{ContextID}/ContextStatus
nodes.description: Reports status of the context. If there was a failure, SettingsPackResponse should be checked for what exactly failed.

nodes.name: Contexts/{ContextID}/SettingsPack
nodes.description: Settings that get applied when the Context is active.

nodes.name: Contexts/{ContextID}/SettingsPackResponse
nodes.description: Response from applying a Settings Pack, contains information on each individual action.

nodes.name: Contexts/{ContextID}/SignalDefinition
nodes.description: Signal Definition XML

nodes.name: NotificationsEnabled
nodes.description: A Boolean value that sets if the user is notified of a context change.

nodes.name: EMAIL2
nodes.description: Root node

nodes.name: {Account GUID}
nodes.description: This is unique and identifies a particular account. Also, we can only have 6 additional email accounts. So, depending on how many are already there on the device, we can have from 1 to 6.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/ACCOUNTICON
nodes.description: The location of the icon associated with the account. The account icon can be used as a tile in the Start list or an icon in the applications list under Settings, email & accounts.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/ACCOUNTTYPE
nodes.description: Specifies the type of account. Valid values are: Email - normal email, VVM - visual voice mail

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/AUTHNAME
nodes.description: Character string that specifies the name used to authorize the user to a specific email account (also known as the user's logon name).

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/AUTHREQUIRED
nodes.description: Character string that specifies whether the outgoing server requires authentication. 1 for TRUE 0 for FALSE(default). Note: If this is not specified then SMTP authentication will not be done.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/AUTHSECRET
nodes.description: Character string that specifies the user's password. The same password is used for SMTP authentication.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/CALENDARSERVER
nodes.description: Server for calendar sync if it is different from the email server.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/CALENDARSERVERREQUIRESSL
nodes.description: Indicates if the connection to the calendar server requires SSL.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/CALENDARSYNCSCHEDULE
nodes.description: Sets the schedule for syncing calendar items.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/CELLULARONLY
nodes.description: If this flag is set, the account only uses the cellular network and not Wi-Fi.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/CONTACTSSERVER
nodes.description: Server for contact sync if it is different from the email server.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/CONTACTSSERVERREQUIRESSL
nodes.description: Indicates if the connection to the contact server requires SSL.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/CONTACTSSYNCSCHEDULE
nodes.description: Sets the schedule for syncing contact items.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/DOMAIN
nodes.description: Character string that specifies the incoming server credentials domain. Limited to 255 characters.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/DWNDAY
nodes.description: Character string that specifies how many days' worth of email should be downloaded from the server.

allowedValues.description: Specifies that all email currently on the server should be downloaded.
Specifies that 7 days’ worth of email should be downloaded.
Specifies that 14 days’ worth of email should be downloaded.
Specifies that 30 days’ worth of email should be downloaded.
Specifies that 90 days’ worth of email should be downloaded.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/INSERVER
nodes.description: Character string that specifies how many days' worth of email should be downloaded from the server. server name:port number

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/KEEPMAX
nodes.description: Specifies the maximum size for a message attachment. Attachments beyond this size will not be downloaded but it will remain on the server. The message itself will be downloaded.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/LINGER
nodes.description: Character string that specifies the length of time between email send/receive updates in minutes. 0 indicates that updates must be performed manually.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/NAME
nodes.description: Character string that specifies the name of the sender displayed on a sent email. It should be set to the user’s name. Limited to 255 characters.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/OUTSERVER
nodes.description: Character string that specifies the name of the messaging service's outgoing email server. Limited to 62 characters. The value format is: server name:port number

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/REPLYADDR
nodes.description: Character string that specifies the reply email address of the user (usually the same as the user email address). Sending email will fail without it. Limited to 255 characters.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/RETRIEVE
nodes.description: Specifies the maximum size in bytes for messages retrieved from the incoming email server. Messages beyond this size are retrieved, but truncated.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/SERVERDELETEACTION
nodes.description: Character string that specifies how message is deleted on server. The default action depends on the transport.

allowedValues.description: keep the message on the server (delete to the Trash folder).

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/SERVICENAME
nodes.description: Character string that specifies the name of the email service to create or edit (32 characters maximum).

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/SERVICETYPE
nodes.description: Character string that specifies the type of email service to create or edit (for example, "IMAP4" or "POP3").

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/SMTPALTAUTHNAME
nodes.description: Character string that specifies the display name associated with the user's alternative SMTP email account.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/SMTPALTDOMAIN
nodes.description: Character string that specifies the domain name for the user's alternative SMTP account.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/SMTPALTENABLED
nodes.description: Character string that specifies if the user's alternate SMTP account is enabled.

allowedValues.description: The user's alternate SMTP email account is disabled.
The user's alternate SMTP email account is enabled.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/SMTPALTPASSWORD
nodes.description: Character string that specifies the password for the user's alternate SMTP account.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/SYNCINGCONTENTTYPES
nodes.description: Specifies a bitmask for which content types are supported for syncing (eg: Mail, Contacts, Calendar).

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/TAGPROPS
nodes.description: Specifies that stated parameter element name attributes is nonstandard tag properties.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/TAGPROPS/8128000B
nodes.description: Character string that specifies if the incoming email server requires SSL.

nodes.name: {Account GUID}/TAGPROPS/812C000B
nodes.description: Character string that specifies if the outgoing email server requires SSL.

nodes.name: EnrollmentStatusTracking
nodes.description: These settings are used to communicate what policies the Enrollment Status Page (ESP) should block on.

nodes.name: DevicePreparation
nodes.description: These settings are read by the Enrollment Status Page (ESP) during the Device Preparation phase.

nodes.name: DevicePreparation/PolicyProviders
nodes.description: These nodes indicate to the Enrollment Status Page (ESP) that it should wait in the Device Preparation phase until all PolicyProviders are installed or marked as not required.

nodes.name: DevicePreparation/PolicyProviders/{ProviderName}
nodes.description: This node represents a policy provider for the Enrollment Status Page (ESP). The node should be given a unique name for the policy provider.

nodes.name: DevicePreparation/PolicyProviders/{ProviderName}/InstallationState
nodes.description: This node communicates the policy provider installation state back to the Enrollment Status Page. Expected values: 1 = NotInstalled, 2 = NotRequired, 3= Completed, 4 = Error.

nodes.name: DevicePreparation/PolicyProviders/{ProviderName}/LastError
nodes.description: If a policy provider fails to install, it can optionally set an HRESULT error code that the Enrollment Status Page can display in an error message to the user.

nodes.name: DevicePreparation/PolicyProviders/{ProviderName}/Timeout
nodes.description: An optional timeout (in minutes) for provider installation to complete before the Enrollment Status Page shows an error.

nodes.name: DevicePreparation/PolicyProviders/{ProviderName}/TrackedResourceTypes
nodes.description: This node's children registers which resource types the policy provider supports for provisioning.

nodes.name: DevicePreparation/PolicyProviders/{ProviderName}/TrackedResourceTypes/Apps
nodes.description: This node registers the policy provider for App provisioning.

nodes.name: Setup
nodes.description: These settings are read by the Enrollment Status Page (ESP) during the Device Setup phase.

nodes.name: Setup/Apps
nodes.description: These settings are used to communicate what policies the Enrollment Status Page (ESP) should block on.

nodes.name: Setup/Apps/PolicyProviders
nodes.description: App policy providers for this CSP. These are the policy providers the ESP should wait on before showing the tracking message with status to the user.

nodes.name: Setup/Apps/PolicyProviders/{ProviderName}
nodes.description: This node represents an app policy provider for the Enrollment Status Page (ESP).

nodes.name: Setup/Apps/PolicyProviders/{ProviderName}/TrackingPoliciesCreated
nodes.description: Indicates when the provider has created the required policies for the ESP to use for tracking app installation progress.

nodes.name: Setup/Apps/Tracking
nodes.description: These are the set of apps that are being tracked by the Enrollment Status Page.

nodes.name: Setup/Apps/Tracking/{ProviderName}
nodes.description: The name of the provider responsible for installing these apps and providing status back to the Enrollment Status Page.

nodes.name: Setup/Apps/Tracking/{ProviderName}/{AppName}
nodes.description: A unique name for the app whose progress should be tracked in the ESP. The app name can be arbitrary as it is not used directly by the ESP, so the value can be defined however the policy provider…

nodes.name: Setup/Apps/Tracking/{ProviderName}/{AppName}/InstallationState
nodes.description: The installation state for the app. This node should be updated by the policy providers (not the MDM server) so the ESP can track the installation progress and update the status message.

nodes.name: Setup/Apps/Tracking/{ProviderName}/{AppName}/RebootRequired
nodes.description: An optional node indicating if the app installation requires the ESP to issue a reboot. This node should be set by the policy provider installing the app (not the MDM server).

nodes.name: Setup/Apps/Tracking/{ProviderName}/{AppName}/TrackingUri
nodes.description: An optional URI to another CSP for tracking the apps installation. If this value is not set, installation status is derived from the InstallationState node.

nodes.name: Setup/HasProvisioningCompleted
nodes.description: This node is set by the Enrollment Status Page (ESP) when it completes. Providers are able to query this node to determine if the ESP is showing, allowing them to bifurcate their logic accordingly.

nodes.name: EnrollmentStatusTracking
nodes.description: These settings are used to communicate what policies the Enrollment Status Page (ESP) should block on.

nodes.name: Setup
nodes.description: These settings are read by the Enrollment Status Page (ESP) during the Account Setup phase.

nodes.name: Setup/Apps
nodes.description: Policy providers use these settings to communicate to the ESP which app installations it should block on and provide progress in the status message to the user.

nodes.name: Setup/Apps/PolicyProviders
nodes.description: These settings are read by the Enrollment Status Page (ESP) during the Device Setup phase.

nodes.name: Setup/Apps/PolicyProviders/{ProviderName}
nodes.description: This node represents an app policy provider for the Enrollment Status Page (ESP).

nodes.name: Setup/Apps/PolicyProviders/{ProviderName}/TrackingPoliciesCreated
nodes.description: Indicates when the provider has created the required policies for the ESP to use for tracking app installation progress.

nodes.name: Setup/Apps/Tracking
nodes.description: This node represents an app policy provider for the Enrollment Status Page (ESP).

nodes.name: Setup/Apps/Tracking/{ProviderName}
nodes.description: The name of the provider responsible for installing these apps and providing status back to the Enrollment Status Page.

nodes.name: Setup/Apps/Tracking/{ProviderName}/{AppName}
nodes.description: A unique name for the app whose progress should be tracked in the ESP. The app name can be arbitrary as it is not used directly by the ESP, so the value can be defined however the policy provider…

nodes.name: Setup/Apps/Tracking/{ProviderName}/{AppName}/InstallationState
nodes.description: The installation state for the app. This node should be updated by the policy providers (not the MDM server) so the ESP can track the installation progress and update the status message.

nodes.name: Setup/Apps/Tracking/{ProviderName}/{AppName}/RebootRequired
nodes.description: An optional node indicating if the app installation requires the ESP to issue a reboot. This node should be set by the policy provider installing the app (not the MDM server).

nodes.name: Setup/Apps/Tracking/{ProviderName}/{AppName}/TrackingUri
nodes.description: An optional URI to another CSP for tracking the apps installation. If this value is not set, installation status is derived from the InstallationState node.

nodes.name: Setup/HasProvisioningCompleted
nodes.description: This node is set by the Enrollment Status Page (ESP) when it completes. Providers are able to query this node to determine if the ESP is showing, allowing them to bifurcate their logic accordingly.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.description: Global settings.

nodes.name: Settings/AllowUserControl
nodes.description: Boolean that specifies whether the cellular UX will allow users to control the visibility of enterprise APNs. Default is false.

nodes.name: Settings/HideView
nodes.description: Boolean that specifies whether the cellular UX will allow the user to view enterprise APNs. Default is false. Only applicable if AllowUserControl is true.

nodes.name: {ConnectionName}
nodes.description: Name of the connection as seen by WCM

nodes.name: {ConnectionName}/APNClassId
nodes.description: GUID that defines the APN class to the modem. This is the same as the OEMConnectionId in CM_CellularEntries.

nodes.name: {ConnectionName}/APNName
nodes.description: Enterprise APN name

nodes.name: {ConnectionName}/AlwaysOn
nodes.description: Boolean that specifies whether the CM will automatically attempt to connect to the APN when a connection is available. Default is true.

nodes.name: {ConnectionName}/AuthType
nodes.description: Authentication type, one of None, Auto, PAP, CHAP, MSCHAPv2

nodes.name: {ConnectionName}/ClassId
nodes.description: GUID that defines the APN class to the modem. This is the same as the OEMConnectionId in CM_CellularEntries.

nodes.name: {ConnectionName}/Enabled
nodes.description: Boolean that specifies whether the connection is enabled. Default is true.

nodes.name: {ConnectionName}/IPType
nodes.description: One of IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6, or IPv4v6xlat, specifying whether the connection supports IPv4 only, IPv6 only, IPv4 and IPv6 concurrently, or IPv6 with IPv4 provided by 46xlat

nodes.name: {ConnectionName}/IccId
nodes.description: ICCID to be associated with the cellular connection profile.If this node is not present, the connection will be created on a single-slot device using the ICCID of the UICC and on a dual-slot device…

nodes.name: {ConnectionName}/IsAttachAPN
nodes.description: Indicates whether this APN should be requested as part of an LTE Attach.

nodes.name: {ConnectionName}/Password
nodes.description: Password corresponding to UserName for PAP, CHAP, and MSCHAPv2 authentication.

nodes.name: {ConnectionName}/Roaming
nodes.description: Roaming setting that specifies whether the connection should be activated when the device is roaming. 0: Disallowed, 1: Allowed, 2: DomesticRoaming, 3: UseOnlyForDomesticRoaming, 4:…

nodes.name: {ConnectionName}/UserName
nodes.description: User name, for use with PAP, CHAP, MSCHAPv2 authentication.

nodes.name: AppVPublishing
nodes.description: Used to monitor publishing operations on App-V.

nodes.name: AppVPublishing/LastSync
nodes.description: Used to monitor publishing status of last Sync operation.

nodes.name: AppVPublishing/LastSync/LastError
nodes.description: Error code and error description of last Sync operation.

nodes.name: AppVPublishing/LastSync/LastErrorDescription
nodes.description: Last Sync error status. One of the following values may be returned: SYNC_ERR_NONE (0) - No errors during publish. SYNC_ERR_UNPUBLISH_GROUPS (1) - Unpublish groups failed during publish.

nodes.name: AppVPublishing/LastSync/SyncProgress
nodes.description: Latest Sync state. One of the following values may be returned: SYNC_STATUS_IDLE (0) - App-V Sync is idle. SYNC_STATUS_PUBLISH_STARTED (1) - App-V Sync is initializing.

nodes.name: AppVPublishing/LastSync/SyncStatusDescription
nodes.description: Latest Sync in-progress stage. One of the following values may be returned: SYNC_PROGRESS_IDLE (0) - App-V publishing is idle.

nodes.name: AppVPublishing/Sync
nodes.description: Used to perform App-V synchronization.

nodes.name: AppVPublishing/Sync/PublishXML
nodes.description: Used to execute the App-V synchronization using the Publishing protocol.

nodes.description: Category of license that is used to classify various license sources. Valid value: Unknown - unknown license category.

nodes.name: AppLicenses/StoreLicenses/{LicenseID}/LicenseUsage

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/ReleaseManagement
nodes.description: Interior node for the managing updates through the Microsoft Store. These settings allow the IT admin to specify update channels for apps that they want their users to use for receiving updates.

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/ReleaseManagement/{ReleaseManagementKey}
nodes.description: Identifier for the app or set of apps. If there is only one app, it is the PackageFamilyName. If it is for a set of apps, it is the PackageFamilyName of the main app.

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/ReleaseManagement/{ReleaseManagementKey}/ChannelId
nodes.description: Specifies the app channel ID.

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/ReleaseManagement/{ReleaseManagementKey}/EffectiveRelease
nodes.description: Interior node used to specify the effective app release to use when multiple user policies are set on the device. The device policy or last user policy is used.

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/ReleaseManagement/{ReleaseManagementKey}/EffectiveRelease/ChannelId
nodes.description: Returns the last user channel ID on the device.

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/ReleaseManagement/{ReleaseManagementKey}/EffectiveRelease/ReleaseManagementId
nodes.description: Returns the last user release ID on the device.

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/ReleaseManagement/{ReleaseManagementKey}/ReleaseManagementId
nodes.description: The IT admin can specify a release ID to indicate a specific release that they would like the user or device to be on.

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/{PackageFamilyName}
nodes.description: Package family name (PFN) of the app. There is one for each PFN on the device when reporting inventory. These items are rooted under their signing origin.

nodes.description: Specifies whether you want to block a specific app from being updated via auto-updates.

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/{PackageFamilyName}/MaintainProcessorArchitectureOnUpdate
nodes.description: Specify whether on a AMD64 device, across an app update, the architecture of the installed app must not change.

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/{PackageFamilyName}/NonRemovable
nodes.description: This setting allows the IT admin to set an app to be nonremovable, or unable to be uninstalled by a user.

allowedValues.description: app is not in the nonremovable app policy list
app is included in the nonremovable app policy list

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/{PackageFamilyName}/{PackageFullName}
nodes.description: Full name of the package installed.

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/{PackageFamilyName}/{PackageFullName}/Architecture
nodes.description: Architecture of installed package. Value type is string.

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/{PackageFamilyName}/{PackageFullName}/InstallDate
nodes.description: Date the app was installed. Value type is string.

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/{PackageFamilyName}/{PackageFullName}/InstallLocation
nodes.description: Install location of the app on the device. Value type is string.

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/{PackageFamilyName}/{PackageFullName}/IsBundle
nodes.description: The value is 1 if the package is an app bundle and 0 (zero) for all other cases. Value type is int.

nodes.description: Whether or not the app is a framework package. Value type is int. The value is 1 if the app is a framework package and 0 (zero) for all other cases.

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/{PackageFamilyName}/{PackageFullName}/IsProvisioned
nodes.description: The value is 0 or 1 that indicates if the app is provisioned on the device. The value type is int.

nodes.description: This node is used to identify whether the package is a stub package. A stub package is a version of the package with minimal functionality that will reduce the size of the app.

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/{PackageFamilyName}/{PackageFullName}/Name
nodes.description: Name of the app. Value type is string.

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/{PackageFamilyName}/{PackageFullName}/PackageStatus
nodes.description: Provides information about the status of the package. Value type is int. Valid values are: OK (0) - The package is usable. LicenseIssue (1) - The license of the package is not valid.

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/{PackageFamilyName}/{PackageFullName}/Publisher
nodes.description: Publisher name of the app. Value type is string.

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/{PackageFamilyName}/{PackageFullName}/RequiresReinstall
nodes.description: Specifies whether the package state has changed and requires a reinstallation of the app.

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/{PackageFamilyName}/{PackageFullName}/ResourceID
nodes.description: Resource ID of the app. This is null for the main app, ~ for a bundle, and contains resource information for resources packages.

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/{PackageFamilyName}/{PackageFullName}/Users

nodes.name: AppManagement/AppStore/{PackageFamilyName}/{PackageFullName}/Version
nodes.description: Version of the app. Value type is string.

nodes.name: AppInstallation

nodes.name: AppInstallation/{PackageFamilyName}/HostedInstall
nodes.description: Command to perform an install of an app package from a hosted location (this can be a local drive, a UNC, or https data source).

nodes.name: AppInstallation/{PackageFamilyName}/LastError

nodes.name: AppInstallation/{PackageFamilyName}/LastErrorDesc
nodes.description: Description of last error relating to the app installation.

nodes.name: AppInstallation/{PackageFamilyName}/ProgressStatus
nodes.description: An integer the indicates the progress of the app installation. For https locations, this indicates the download progress.

nodes.name: AppInstallation/{PackageFamilyName}/Status
nodes.description: Status of app installation. The following values are returned: NOT_INSTALLED (0) - The node was added, but the execution has not completed.

nodes.name: AppInstallation/{PackageFamilyName}/StoreInstall

nodes.name: AppLicenses/StoreLicenses/{LicenseID}/LicenseCategory
nodes.description: Category of license that is used to classify various license sources. Valid value: Unknown - unknown license category.

nodes.name: AppLicenses/StoreLicenses/{LicenseID}/LicenseUsage
nodes.description: Indicates the allowed usage for the license. Valid values: Unknown - usage is unknown. Online - the license is only valid for online usage.

nodes.name: AppLicenses/StoreLicenses/{LicenseID}/RequesterID
