nodes.name: Firewall
nodes.description: Root node for the Firewall configuration service provider.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DomainProfile/AllowLocalIpsecPolicyMerge
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DomainProfile/AllowLocalPolicyMerge
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is false, firewall rules from the local store are ignored and not enforced.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DomainProfile/AuthAppsAllowUserPrefMerge
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is false, authorized application firewall rules in the local store are ignored and not enforced.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DomainProfile/DefaultInboundAction
nodes.description: This value is the action that the firewall does by default (and evaluates at the very end) on inbound connections. The allow action is represented by 0x00000000; 0x00000001 represents a block action.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DomainProfile/DefaultOutboundAction
nodes.description: This value is the action that the firewall does by default (and evaluates at the very end) on outbound connections. The allow action is represented by 0x00000000; 0x00000001 represents a block action.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DomainProfile/DisableInboundNotifications
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch. If this value is false, the firewall MAY display a notification to the user when an application is blocked from listening on a port.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DomainProfile/DisableStealthMode
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch. When this option is false, the server operates in stealth mode. The firewall rules used to enforce stealth mode are implementation-specific.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DomainProfile/DisableStealthModeIpsecSecuredPacketExemption
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch. This option is ignored if DisableStealthMode is on.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DomainProfile/DisableUnicastResponsesToMulticastBroadcast
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If it is true, unicast responses to multicast broadcast traffic is blocked.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DomainProfile/EnableFirewall
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch for the firewall and advanced security enforcement. If this value is false, the server MUST NOT block any network traffic, regardless of other policy settings.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DomainProfile/EnableLogDroppedPackets
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is on, the firewall logs all the dropped packets. The merge law for this option is to let "on" values win.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DomainProfile/EnableLogIgnoredRules
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. The server MAY use this value in an implementation-specific way to control logging of events if a rule is not enforced for any reason.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DomainProfile/EnableLogSuccessConnections
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is on, the firewall logs all successful inbound connections. The merge law for this option is to let "on" values win.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DomainProfile/GlobalPortsAllowUserPrefMerge
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is false, global port firewall rules in the local store are ignored and not enforced.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DomainProfile/LogFilePath
nodes.description: This value is a string that represents a file path to the log where the firewall logs dropped packets and successful connections.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DomainProfile/LogMaxFileSize
nodes.description: This value specifies the size, in kilobytes, of the log file where dropped packets and successful connections are logged.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DomainProfile/Shielded
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is on and EnableFirewall is on, the server MUST block all incoming traffic regardless of other policy settings.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DynamicKeywords/Addresses
nodes.description: A list of dynamic keyword addresses for use within firewall rules.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DynamicKeywords/Addresses/{Id}
nodes.description: A unique GUID string identifier for this dynamic keyword address.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DynamicKeywords/Addresses/{Id}/Addresses
nodes.description: Consists of one or more comma-delimited tokens specifying the addresses covered by this keyword. This value should not be set if AutoResolve is true.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DynamicKeywords/Addresses/{Id}/AutoResolve
nodes.description: If this flag is set to TRUE, then the 'keyword' field of this object is expected to be a fully qualified domain name, and the addresses will be automatically resolved.

nodes.name: MdmStore/DynamicKeywords/Addresses/{Id}/Keyword
nodes.description: A String reprsenting keyword. If the AutoResolve value is true, this should be a Fully Qualified Domain name (wildcards accepted, for example "contoso.com" or "*.contoso.com").

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules
nodes.description: A list of rules controlling traffic through the Windows Firewall. Each Rule ID is ORed. Within each rule ID each Filter type is AND'ed.

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}
nodes.description: Unique alpha numeric identifier for the rule. The rule name must not include a forward slash (/).

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/Action
nodes.description: Specifies the action for the rule.

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/Action/Type
nodes.description: Specifies the action the rule enforces: 0 - Block 1 - Allow

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/App
nodes.description: Rules that control connections for an app, program or service. Specified based on the intersection of the following nodes. PackageFamilyName FilePath FQBN ServiceName

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/App/FilePath
nodes.description: FilePath - This App/Id value represents the full file path of the app. For example, C:\Windows\System\Notepad.exe.

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/App/Fqbn
nodes.description: Fully Qualified Binary Name

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/App/PackageFamilyName
nodes.description: PackageFamilyName - This App/Id value represents the PackageFamilyName of the app. The PackageFamilyName is the unique name of a Microsoft Store application.

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/App/ServiceName
nodes.description: This is a service name, and is used in cases when a service, not an application, must be sending or receiving traffic.

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/Description
nodes.description: Specifies the description of the rule.

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/Direction
nodes.description: The rule is enabled based on the traffic direction as following. IN - the rule applies to inbound traffic. OUT - the rule applies to outbound traffic. If not specified the detault is OUT.

allowedValues.description: The rule applies to inbound traffic.
The rule applies to outbound traffic.

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/EdgeTraversal
nodes.description: Indicates whether edge traversal is enabled or disabled for this rule.

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/Enabled
nodes.description: Indicates whether the rule is enabled or disabled. If not specified - a new rule is enabled by default.

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/IcmpTypesAndCodes
nodes.description: String value.

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/InterfaceTypes
nodes.description: String value.

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/LocalAddressRanges
nodes.description: Consists of one or more comma-delimited tokens specifying the local addresses covered by the rule. "*" is the default value. Valid tokens include: "*" indicates any local address.

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/LocalPortRanges
nodes.description: Comma Separated list of ranges for eg. 100-120,200,300-320. If not specified the default is All.

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/LocalUserAuthorizedList
nodes.description: Specifies the list of authorized local users for the app container. This is a string in Security Descriptor Definition Language (SDDL) format..

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/Name
nodes.description: Specifies the friendly name of the firewall rule.

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/PolicyAppId
nodes.description: Specifies one WDAC tag.

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/Profiles
nodes.description: Specifies the profiles to which the rule belongs: Domain, Private, Public. See FW_PROFILE_TYPE for the bitmasks that are used to identify profile types. If not specified, the default is All.

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/Protocol
nodes.description: 0-255 number representing the ip protocol (TCP = 6, UDP = 17). If not specified the default is All.

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/RemoteAddressDynamicKeywords
nodes.description: Comma separated list of Dynamic Keyword Address Ids (GUID strings) specifying the remote addresses covered by the rule.

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/RemoteAddressRanges
nodes.description: Consists of one or more comma-delimited tokens specifying the remote addresses covered by the rule. The default value is "*". Valid tokens include: "*" indicates any remote address.

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/RemotePortRanges
nodes.description: Comma Separated list of ranges for eg. 100-120,200,300-320. If not specified the default is All.

nodes.name: MdmStore/FirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/Status
nodes.description: Provides information about the specific verrsion of the rule in deployment for monitoring purposes.

nodes.name: MdmStore/Global/BinaryVersionSupported
nodes.description: This value contains the binary version of the structures and data types that are supported by the server. This value is not merged.

nodes.name: MdmStore/Global/CRLcheck
nodes.description: This value specifies how certificate revocation list (CRL) verification is enforced. The value MUST be 0, 1, or 2. A value of 0 disables CRL checking.

allowedValues.description: Specifies that CRL checking is attempted and that certificate validation fails only if the certificate is revoked. Other failures that are encountered during CRL checking (such as the revocation URL being unreachable) do not cause certificate validation to fail.
Means that checking is required and that certificate validation fails if any error is encountered during CRL processing

nodes.name: MdmStore/Global/CurrentProfiles
nodes.description: Value that contains a bitmask of the current enforced profiles that are maintained by the server firewall host. See FW_PROFILE_TYPE for the bitmasks that are used to identify profile types.

nodes.name: MdmStore/Global/DisableStatefulFtp
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch. If off, the firewall performs stateful File Transfer Protocol (FTP) filtering to allow secondary connections.

nodes.name: MdmStore/Global/EnableAuditMode
nodes.description: This value specifies if the target machine is in Firewall Audit Mode.

allowedValues.description: Indicates that Audit mode is disabled
Indicates that Audit mode is enabled

nodes.name: MdmStore/Global/EnablePacketQueue
nodes.description: This value specifies how scaling for the software on the receive side is enabled for both the encrypted receive and clear text forward path for the IPsec tunnel gateway scenario.

nodes.name: MdmStore/Global/IPsecExempt
nodes.description: This value configures IPsec exceptions and MUST be a combination of the valid flags that are defined in IPSEC_EXEMPT_VALUES; therefore, the maximum value MUST always be IPSEC_EXEMPT_MAX-1 for servers…

nodes.name: MdmStore/Global/OpportunisticallyMatchAuthSetPerKM
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch.

nodes.name: MdmStore/Global/PolicyVersion
nodes.description: This value contains the policy version of the policy store being managed. This value is not merged and therefore, has no merge law.

nodes.name: MdmStore/Global/PolicyVersionSupported
nodes.description: Value that contains the maximum policy version that the server host can accept. The version number is two octets in size.

nodes.name: MdmStore/Global/PresharedKeyEncoding
nodes.description: Specifies the preshared key encoding that is used. MUST be a valid value from the PRESHARED_KEY_ENCODING_VALUES enumeration.

allowedValues.description: FW_GLOBAL_CONFIG_PRESHARED_KEY_ENCODING_NONE: Preshared key is not encoded. Instead, it is kept in its wide-character format. This symbolic constant has a value of 0.
FW_GLOBAL_CONFIG_PRESHARED_KEY_ENCODING_UTF_8: Encode the preshared key using UTF-8. This symbolic constant has a value of 1.

nodes.name: MdmStore/Global/SaIdleTime
nodes.description: This value configures the security association idle time, in seconds. Security associations are deleted after network traffic is not seen for this specified period of time.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVFirewallRules
nodes.description: A list of rules controlling traffic through the Windows Firewall for Hyper-V containers. Each Rule ID is ORed. Within each rule ID each Filter type is AND'ed.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVFirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}
nodes.description: Unique alpha numeric identifier for the rule. The rule name must not include a forward slash (/).

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVFirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/Action
nodes.description: Specifies the action the rule enforces: 0 - Block 1 - Allow

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVFirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/Direction
nodes.description: The rule is enabled based on the traffic direction as following. IN - the rule applies to inbound traffic. OUT - the rule applies to outbound traffic. If not specified the detault is OUT.

allowedValues.description: The rule applies to inbound traffic.
The rule applies to outbound traffic.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVFirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/Enabled
nodes.description: Indicates whether the rule is enabled or disabled. If not specified - a new rule is enabled by default.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVFirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/LocalAddressRanges
nodes.description: Consists of one or more comma-delimited tokens specifying the local addresses covered by the rule. "*" is the default value. Valid tokens include: "*" indicates any local address.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVFirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/LocalPortRanges
nodes.description: Comma Separated list of ranges for eg. 100-120,200,300-320. If not specified the default is All.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVFirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/Name
nodes.description: Specifies the friendly name of the Hyper-V Firewall rule.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVFirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/Priority
nodes.description: This value represents the order of rule enforcement. A lower priority rule is evaluated first. If not specified, block rules are evaluated before allow rules.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVFirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/Profiles
nodes.description: Specifies the profiles to which the rule belongs: Domain, Private, Public. See FW_PROFILE_TYPE for the bitmasks that are used to identify profile types. If not specified, the default is All.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVFirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/Protocol
nodes.description: 0-255 number representing the ip protocol (TCP = 6, UDP = 17). If not specified the default is All.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVFirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/RemoteAddressRanges
nodes.description: Consists of one or more comma-delimited tokens specifying the remote addresses covered by the rule. The default value is "*". Valid tokens include: "*" indicates any remote address.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVFirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/RemotePortRanges
nodes.description: Comma Separated list of ranges for eg. 100-120,200,300-320. If not specified the default is All.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVFirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/Status
nodes.description: Provides information about the specific version of the rule in deployment for monitoring purposes.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVFirewallRules/{FirewallRuleName}/VMCreatorId
nodes.description: This field specifies the VM Creator ID that this rule is applicable to. A NULL GUID will result in this rule applying to all VM creators.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVVMSettings
nodes.description: Settings for the Windows Firewall for Hyper-V containers. Each setting applies on a per-VM Creator basis.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVVMSettings/{VMCreatorId}
nodes.description: VM Creator ID that these settings apply to. Valid format is a GUID

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVVMSettings/{VMCreatorId}/AllowHostPolicyMerge
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is true, applicable host firewall rules and settings will be applied to Hyper-V Firewall.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVVMSettings/{VMCreatorId}/DefaultInboundAction
nodes.description: This value is the action that the Hyper-V Firewall does by default (and evaluates at the very end) on inbound connections.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVVMSettings/{VMCreatorId}/DefaultOutboundAction
nodes.description: This value is the action that the Hyper-V Firewall does by default (and evaluates at the very end) on outbound connections.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVVMSettings/{VMCreatorId}/DomainProfile/AllowLocalPolicyMerge
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is false, Hyper-V Firewall rules from the local store are ignored and not enforced.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVVMSettings/{VMCreatorId}/DomainProfile/DefaultInboundAction
nodes.description: This value is the action that the Hyper-V Firewall does by default (and evaluates at the very end) on inbound connections.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVVMSettings/{VMCreatorId}/DomainProfile/DefaultOutboundAction
nodes.description: This value is the action that the Hyper-V Firewall does by default (and evaluates at the very end) on outbound connections.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVVMSettings/{VMCreatorId}/DomainProfile/EnableFirewall
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch for the Hyper-V Firewall enforcement.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVVMSettings/{VMCreatorId}/EnableFirewall
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch for the Hyper-V Firewall. This value controls the settings for all profiles. It is recommended to instead use the profile setting value under the profile subtree.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVVMSettings/{VMCreatorId}/EnableLoopback
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch for loopback traffic. This determines if this VM is able to send/receive loopback traffic to other VMs or the host.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVVMSettings/{VMCreatorId}/PrivateProfile/AllowLocalPolicyMerge
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is false, Hyper-V Firewall rules from the local store are ignored and not enforced.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVVMSettings/{VMCreatorId}/PrivateProfile/DefaultInboundAction
nodes.description: This value is the action that the Hyper-V Firewall does by default (and evaluates at the very end) on inbound connections.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVVMSettings/{VMCreatorId}/PrivateProfile/DefaultOutboundAction
nodes.description: This value is the action that the Hyper-V Firewall does by default (and evaluates at the very end) on outbound connections.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVVMSettings/{VMCreatorId}/PrivateProfile/EnableFirewall
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch for the Hyper-V Firewall enforcement.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVVMSettings/{VMCreatorId}/PublicProfile/AllowLocalPolicyMerge
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is false, Hyper-V Firewall rules from the local store are ignored and not enforced.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVVMSettings/{VMCreatorId}/PublicProfile/DefaultInboundAction
nodes.description: This value is the action that the Hyper-V Firewall does by default (and evaluates at the very end) on inbound connections.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVVMSettings/{VMCreatorId}/PublicProfile/DefaultOutboundAction
nodes.description: This value is the action that the Hyper-V Firewall does by default (and evaluates at the very end) on outbound connections.

nodes.name: MdmStore/HyperVVMSettings/{VMCreatorId}/PublicProfile/EnableFirewall
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch for the Hyper-V Firewall enforcement.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PrivateProfile/AllowLocalIpsecPolicyMerge
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PrivateProfile/AllowLocalPolicyMerge
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is false, firewall rules from the local store are ignored and not enforced.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PrivateProfile/AuthAppsAllowUserPrefMerge
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is false, authorized application firewall rules in the local store are ignored and not enforced.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PrivateProfile/DefaultInboundAction
nodes.description: This value is the action that the firewall does by default (and evaluates at the very end) on inbound connections. The allow action is represented by 0x00000000; 0x00000001 represents a block action.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PrivateProfile/DefaultOutboundAction
nodes.description: This value is the action that the firewall does by default (and evaluates at the very end) on outbound connections. The allow action is represented by 0x00000000; 0x00000001 represents a block action.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PrivateProfile/DisableInboundNotifications
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch. If this value is false, the firewall MAY display a notification to the user when an application is blocked from listening on a port.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PrivateProfile/DisableStealthMode
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch. When this option is false, the server operates in stealth mode. The firewall rules used to enforce stealth mode are implementation-specific.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PrivateProfile/DisableStealthModeIpsecSecuredPacketExemption
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch. This option is ignored if DisableStealthMode is on.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PrivateProfile/DisableUnicastResponsesToMulticastBroadcast
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If it is true, unicast responses to multicast broadcast traffic is blocked.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PrivateProfile/EnableFirewall
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch for the firewall and advanced security enforcement. If this value is false, the server MUST NOT block any network traffic, regardless of other policy settings.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PrivateProfile/EnableLogDroppedPackets
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is on, the firewall logs all the dropped packets. The merge law for this option is to let "on" values win.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PrivateProfile/EnableLogIgnoredRules
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. The server MAY use this value in an implementation-specific way to control logging of events if a rule is not enforced for any reason.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PrivateProfile/EnableLogSuccessConnections
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is on, the firewall logs all successful inbound connections. The merge law for this option is to let "on" values win.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PrivateProfile/GlobalPortsAllowUserPrefMerge
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is false, global port firewall rules in the local store are ignored and not enforced.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PrivateProfile/LogFilePath
nodes.description: This value is a string that represents a file path to the log where the firewall logs dropped packets and successful connections.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PrivateProfile/LogMaxFileSize
nodes.description: This value specifies the size, in kilobytes, of the log file where dropped packets and successful connections are logged.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PrivateProfile/Shielded
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is on and EnableFirewall is on, the server MUST block all incoming traffic regardless of other policy settings.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PublicProfile/AllowLocalIpsecPolicyMerge
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PublicProfile/AllowLocalPolicyMerge
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is false, firewall rules from the local store are ignored and not enforced.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PublicProfile/AuthAppsAllowUserPrefMerge
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is false, authorized application firewall rules in the local store are ignored and not enforced.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PublicProfile/DefaultInboundAction
nodes.description: This value is the action that the firewall does by default (and evaluates at the very end) on inbound connections. The allow action is represented by 0x00000000; 0x00000001 represents a block action.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PublicProfile/DefaultOutboundAction
nodes.description: This value is the action that the firewall does by default (and evaluates at the very end) on outbound connections. The allow action is represented by 0x00000000; 0x00000001 represents a block action.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PublicProfile/DisableInboundNotifications
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch. If this value is false, the firewall MAY display a notification to the user when an application is blocked from listening on a port.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PublicProfile/DisableStealthMode
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch. When this option is false, the server operates in stealth mode. The firewall rules used to enforce stealth mode are implementation-specific.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PublicProfile/DisableStealthModeIpsecSecuredPacketExemption
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch. This option is ignored if DisableStealthMode is on.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PublicProfile/DisableUnicastResponsesToMulticastBroadcast
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If it is true, unicast responses to multicast broadcast traffic is blocked.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PublicProfile/EnableFirewall
nodes.description: This value is an on/off switch for the firewall and advanced security enforcement. If this value is false, the server MUST NOT block any network traffic, regardless of other policy settings.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PublicProfile/EnableLogDroppedPackets
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is on, the firewall logs all the dropped packets. The merge law for this option is to let "on" values win.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PublicProfile/EnableLogIgnoredRules
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. The server MAY use this value in an implementation-specific way to control logging of events if a rule is not enforced for any reason.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PublicProfile/EnableLogSuccessConnections
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is on, the firewall logs all successful inbound connections. The merge law for this option is to let "on" values win.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PublicProfile/GlobalPortsAllowUserPrefMerge
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is false, global port firewall rules in the local store are ignored and not enforced.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PublicProfile/LogFilePath
nodes.description: This value is a string that represents a file path to the log where the firewall logs dropped packets and successful connections.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PublicProfile/LogMaxFileSize
nodes.description: This value specifies the size, in kilobytes, of the log file where dropped packets and successful connections are logged.

nodes.name: MdmStore/PublicProfile/Shielded
nodes.description: This value is used as an on/off switch. If this value is on and EnableFirewall is on, the server MUST block all incoming traffic regardless of other policy settings.

nodes.name: HealthAttestation
nodes.description: The root node for the device HealthAttestation configuration service provider.

nodes.name: AttestErrorMessage
nodes.description: AttestErrorMessage maintains the error message for the last attestation session, if returned by the attestation service.

nodes.name: AttestStatus
nodes.description: AttestStatus maintains the success or failure status code for the last attestation session.

nodes.name: Certificate
nodes.description: Instructs the DHA-CSP to forward DHA-Data to the MDM server.

nodes.name: CorrelationID
nodes.description: Identifies a unique device health attestation session. CorrelationId is used to correlate DHA-Service logs with the MDM server events and Client event logs for debug and troubleshooting.

nodes.name: CurrentProtocolVersion
nodes.description: Provides the current protocol version that the client is using to communicate with the Health Attestation Service.

nodes.name: ForceRetrieve
nodes.description: Instructs the client to initiate a new request to DHA-Service, and get a new DHA-EncBlob (a summary of the boot state that is issued by DHA-Service).

nodes.name: GetAttestReport
nodes.description: Retrieve attestation session report if exists.

nodes.name: GetServiceCorrelationIDs
nodes.description: Retrieve service correlation IDs if exist.

nodes.name: HASEndpoint
nodes.description: Identifies the fully qualified domain name (FQDN) of the DHA-Service that is assigned to perform attestation.

nodes.name: MaxSupportedProtocolVersion
nodes.description: Returns the maximum protocol version that this client can support.

nodes.name: Nonce
nodes.description: Enables MDMs to protect the device health attestation communications from man-in-the-middle type (MITM) attacks with a crypt-protected random value that is generated by the MDM Server.

nodes.name: PreferredMaxProtocolVersion
nodes.description: Provides the maximum preferred protocol version that the client is configured to communicate over.

nodes.name: Status
nodes.description: Provides the current status of the device health request.

nodes.name: TpmReadyStatus
nodes.description: Returns a bitmask of information describing the state of TPM. It indicates whether the TPM of the device is in a ready and trusted state.

nodes.name: TriggerAttestation
nodes.description: Notifies the device to trigger an attestation session asynchronously.

nodes.name: VerifyHealth
nodes.description: Notifies the device to prepare a device health verification request.

nodes.name: KeyboardFilter
nodes.description: Keyboard Filter CSP Root node

nodes.name: BlockedKeys
nodes.description: Get operations return a comma-delimited string of keys and key combinations that are currently blocked. Returned list does not include scancodes that have been blocked.

nodes.name: BlockedScancodes
nodes.description: Get operations return a comma-delimited string of scancodes and modifier+scancode combinations that are currently blocked in hexadecimal format without the "0x" prefix.

nodes.name: BreakoutKeyScancode
nodes.description: Get or set the scancode that forces the device to the login screen when pressed five times consecutively. The value is the string representation of the hexadecimal scancode (without the "0x" prefix).

nodes.name: DisableAccessibilitySettings
nodes.description: Determines if Accessibility settings (e.g. Ease of Access) are disabled. Defaults to false.

nodes.name: DisableKeyboardFilterForAdministrators
nodes.description: Determines if Keyboard Filter should be disabled for administrators. Defaults to false. If an admin is currently signed in when this value is set, it will take effect on the next sign-in.

allowedValues.description: Blocked keys and scancodes are blocked for Administrators
Blocked keys and scancodes are not blocked for Administrators

nodes.name: Status
nodes.description: Returns the current status of the Keyboard Filter feature 0: Status unknown (default) 1: Keyboard Filter is currently enabled 2: Keyboard Filter is currently disabled 3: Keyboard Filter is not…

allowedValues.description: Not supported on this OS edition

nodes.name: {KioskName}
nodes.description: This node describes a kiosk profile. A device can have multiple kiosk profiles of different types and lockdown policies.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllAppsFullScreen
nodes.description: Specifies if applications other than the primary app allowed in a Shell Replacement Kiosk should launch in full screen mode.

allowedValues.description: Only the primary application should be run in full screen mode
All applications should run in full screen mode

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowAnyApp
nodes.description: Controls if applications outside of the apps listed under AllowedApps are allowed to run in this Shell Replacement Kiosk. If set to false, only the apps listed under AllowedApps may run.

allowedValues.description: Only apps listed under AllowedApps are allowed to run in this Shell Replacement Kiosk
Any app can run in this Shell Replacement Kiosk

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedApps
nodes.description: Sets the applications that are allowed to run in the kiosk.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedApps/{AppName}
nodes.description: An application that is allowed to run in the kiosk.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedApps/{AppName}/AUMID
nodes.description: The Application User Model ID, aka AUMID, that uniquely identifies a packaged Windows app

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedApps/{AppName}/AppType
nodes.description: Specifies if the application is a classic Win32 app, a modern packaged app, an edge kiosk, or a weblink.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedApps/{AppName}/AutoLaunch
nodes.description: Indicates whether the application should automatically launch when the user signs in to a Restricted Desktop Experience Kiosk. Only one application can be designated to autolaunch.

allowedValues.description: Application should not automatically launch when the user signs in to a Restricted Desktop Experience Kiosk.
Application is the primary app that should automatically launch when the user signs in to a Restricted Desktop Experience Kiosk.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedApps/{AppName}/AutoLaunchArguments
nodes.description: The command-line arguments to pass to the application executable that is set to automatically launch.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedApps/{AppName}/DefaultExitAction
nodes.description: Specifies the default action to take when kiosk application exits. Only applies to the primary application in Shell Replacement Kiosks.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedApps/{AppName}/EdgeKioskIdleTimeoutMinutes
nodes.description: The time (in minutes) from the last user activity before Microsoft Edge Kiosk mode resets the user's session by restarting the browser

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedApps/{AppName}/EdgeKioskType
nodes.description: The type of Edge Kiosk. 0 maps to a Digital Sign kiosk, and 1 maps to a Public Browsing Kiosk

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedApps/{AppName}/ExitCodeActions
nodes.description: Specifies the actions to take when the kiosk application exits with specific exit codes. Only applies to the primary application in Shell Replacement Kiosks.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedApps/{AppName}/ExitCodeActions/{ExitCodeAction}
nodes.description: An action to take when an application returns a specific exit code. Only applies to the primary application in Shell Replacement Kiosks.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedApps/{AppName}/ExitCodeActions/{ExitCodeAction}/ExitAction
nodes.description: The exit code returned by the application that triggers this ExitCodeAction. Only applies to the primary application in Shell Replacement Kiosks.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedApps/{AppName}/ExitCodeActions/{ExitCodeAction}/ExitCode
nodes.description: The exit code under which this ExitCodeAction should be taken. Only applies to the primary application in Shell Replacement Kiosks.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedApps/{AppName}/IsPrimaryApp
nodes.description: Sets the application as the Primary Application that replaces the Windows desktop. Exactly one application must be designated as the Primary Application in a Shell Replacement Kiosk.

allowedValues.description: Application should not replace the Windows desktop shell.
Application is the primary app that replaces the Windows desktop shell.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedApps/{AppName}/Path
nodes.description: The file system path to the application executable. Accepts paths to the application's binary (.exe) or a shell link (.lnk) that points to the application

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedApps/{AppName}/PrimaryAppArguments
nodes.description: Specifies the command-line arguments to pass to the primary application when it is launched. Only applies to the primary application in Shell Replacement Kiosks.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedApps/{AppName}/StartPinOrder
nodes.description: A number representing the order in which the application should be pinned to the Start menu. Each StartPinOrder value must be unique within a kiosk profile.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedApps/{AppName}/TaskbarPinOrder
nodes.description: A number representing the order in which the application should be pinned to the Taskbar. Each TaskbarPinOrder value must be unique within a kiosk profile.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedApps/{AppName}/URL
nodes.description: For either the Edge Kiosk or Weblink application types, the URL of the website launched

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedFileExplorerLocations
nodes.description: Specifies the file explorer locations that the user can access in this kiosk. If no locations are specified under this node, the kiosk will not have access to any file explorer locations.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedFileExplorerLocations/{AllowedLocation}
nodes.description: A file explorer location that the user can access in this kiosk.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AllowedFileExplorerLocations/{AllowedLocation}/FileExplorerLocation
nodes.description: The file explorer location to allow access to

allowedValues.description: This PC, which includes all drives and folders on the system

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AssignedAccounts
nodes.description: Specifies the accounts (users or groups) that are assigned to this kiosk profile.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AssignedAccounts/{AccountName}
nodes.description: An account (user or group) that should be assigned to this kiosk profile. Accounts must be created before the kiosk has been configured. Each account can be assigned to only one kiosk profile.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AssignedAccounts/{AccountName}/AccountId
nodes.description: The name or GUID for the account. Local users are specified by the username. ActiveDirectory users are specified by the format domain\username.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AssignedAccounts/{AccountName}/AccountType
nodes.description: The type of account to assign to this kiosk profile. Accounts can be users or groups

allowedValues.description: An AutoLogon user account, a special user created and managed by the kiosk feature that automatically logs on when the device boots. Only one AutoLogonAccount is allowed per device.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/AssignedAccounts/{AccountName}/AutoLogonAccountDisplayName
nodes.description: The display name of the AutoLogon account shown on the Lock screen.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/BreakoutSequence
nodes.description: Specifies the key sequence that allows users to exit a Shell Replacement kiosk. By default, users can press Ctrl+Alt+Del to exit Shell Replacement kiosks.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/Customizations
nodes.description: Specifies the user experience customizations for the kiosk profile.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/Customizations/{Customization}
nodes.description: A customization for the kiosk profile.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/Customizations/{Customization}/CustomizationName
nodes.description: The name of the customization. This must match one of the documented Kiosk user experience customization names.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/Customizations/{Customization}/CustomizationValue
nodes.description: If applicable, the value to set the customization to.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/IsDefaultProfile
nodes.description: Specifies if this kiosk should be the default profile for all users on the device. If enabled, any user that is not assigned a specific kiosk profile will use this one as the default.

allowedValues.description: Do not set as the default kiosk profile
Set as the default kiosk profile

nodes.name: {KioskName}/KioskType
nodes.description: Configures the kiosk to either keep the Windows desktop but restrict the user experience, or to replace the Windows desktop with an alternate primary app experience.

nodes.name: {KioskName}/ShowTaskbar
nodes.description: Specifies if the Taskbar should be shown or automatically hidden in a Restricted Experience Kiosk.

nodes.name: LAPS
nodes.description: The root node for the LAPS configuration service provider.

nodes.name: Actions/ResetPassword
nodes.description: Use this setting to tell the CSP to immediately generate and store a new password for the managed local administrator account.

nodes.name: Actions/ResetPasswordStatus
nodes.description: Use this setting to query the status of the last submitted ResetPassword execute action.

nodes.name: Policies
nodes.description: Root node for LAPS policies.

nodes.name: Policies/ADEncryptedPasswordHistorySize
nodes.description: Use this setting to configure how many previous encrypted passwords will be remembered in Active Directory. If not specified, this setting will default to 0 passwords (disabled).

nodes.name: Policies/ADPasswordEncryptionEnabled
nodes.description: Use this setting to configure whether the password is encrypted before being stored in Active Directory.

allowedValues.description: Store the password in clear-text form in Active Directory
Store the password in encrypted form in Active Directory

nodes.name: Policies/ADPasswordEncryptionPrincipal
nodes.description: Use this setting to configure the name or SID of a user or group that can decrypt the password stored in Active Directory.

nodes.name: Policies/AdministratorAccountName
nodes.description: Use this setting to configure the name of the managed local administrator account.

nodes.name: Policies/AutomaticAccountManagementEnableAccount
nodes.description: Use this setting to configure whether the automatically managed account is enabled or disabled. If this setting is enabled, the target account will be enabled.

allowedValues.description: The target account will be disabled
The target account will be enabled

nodes.name: Policies/AutomaticAccountManagementEnabled
nodes.description: Use this setting to specify whether automatic account management is enabled. If this setting is enabled, the target account will be automatically managed.

allowedValues.description: The target account will not be automatically managed
The target account will be automatically managed

nodes.name: Policies/AutomaticAccountManagementNameOrPrefix
nodes.description: Use this setting to configure the name or prefix of the managed local administrator account. If specified, the value will be used as the name or name prefix of the managed account.

nodes.name: Policies/AutomaticAccountManagementRandomizeName
nodes.description: Use this setting to configure whether the name of the automatically managed account uses a random numeric suffix each time the password is rotated.

allowedValues.description: The name of the target account will not use a random numeric suffix.
The name of the target account will use a random numeric suffix.

nodes.name: Policies/AutomaticAccountManagementTarget
nodes.description: Use this setting to configure which account is automatically managed.

allowedValues.description: Manage a new custom administrator account

nodes.name: Policies/BackupDirectory
nodes.description: Use this setting to configure which directory the local admin account password is backed up to.

allowedValues.description: Disabled (password will not be backed up)
Backup the password to Microsoft Entra ID only
Backup the password to Active Directory only

nodes.name: Policies/PassphraseLength
nodes.description: Use this setting to configure the number of passphrase words. If not specified, this setting will default to 6 words This setting has a minimum allowed value of 3 words.

nodes.name: Policies/PasswordAgeDays

nodes.description: Use this setting to specify the actions to take upon expiration of the configured grace period. If not specified, this setting will default to 3 (Reset the password and logoff the managed account).

allowedValues.description: Reset password: upon expiry of the grace period, the managed account password will be reset.

Reset the password and logoff the managed account: upon expiry of the grace period, the managed account password will be reset and any interactive logon sessions using the managed account will terminated.
Reset the password and reboot: upon expiry of the grace period, the managed account password will be reset and the managed device will be immediately rebooted.

Reset the password, logoff the managed account, and terminate any remaining processes: upon expiration of the grace period, the managed account password is reset, any interactive logon sessions using the managed account are logged off, and any remaining processes are terminated.
