nodes.description: Specifies whether to prevent the MS-DOS subsystem (ntvdm.exe) from running on this computer. This setting affects the launching of 16-bit applications in the operating system.

nodes.name: AppCompatRemoveProgramCompatPropPage
nodes.description: This policy controls the visibility of the Program Compatibility property page shell extension. This shell extension is visible on the property context-menu of any program shortcut or executable file.

nodes.name: AppCompatTurnOffApplicationImpactTelemetry
nodes.description: The policy controls the state of the Application Telemetry engine in the system. Application Telemetry is a mechanism that tracks anonymous usage of specific Windows system components by applications.

nodes.name: AppCompatTurnOffEngine
nodes.description: This policy controls the state of the application compatibility engine in the system.

nodes.name: AppCompatTurnOffProgramCompatibilityAssistant_1
nodes.description: This setting exists only for backward compatibility, and isn't valid for this version of Windows.

nodes.name: AppCompatTurnOffProgramCompatibilityAssistant_2
nodes.description: This policy setting controls the state of the Program Compatibility Assistant (PCA). The PCA monitors applications run by the user.

nodes.name: AppCompatTurnOffProgramInventory
nodes.description: This policy setting controls the state of the Inventory Collector. The Inventory Collector inventories applications, files, devices, and drivers on the system and sends the information to Microsoft.

nodes.name: AppCompatTurnOffSwitchBack
nodes.description: The policy controls the state of the Switchback compatibility engine in the system.

nodes.name: AppCompatTurnOffUserActionRecord
nodes.description: This policy setting controls the state of Steps Recorder. Steps Recorder keeps a record of steps taken by the user.

nodes.name: AppxRuntimeApplicationContentUriRules
nodes.description: This policy setting lets you turn on Content URI Rules to supplement the static Content URI Rules that were defined as part of the app manifest and apply to all packaged Microsoft Store apps that use…

nodes.name: AppxRuntimeBlockFileElevation
nodes.description: This policy setting lets you control whether packaged Microsoft Store apps can open files using the default desktop app for a file type.

nodes.name: AppxRuntimeBlockHostedAppAccessWinRT
nodes.description: This policy setting controls whether Universal Windows apps with Windows Runtime API access directly from web content can be launched.

nodes.name: AppxRuntimeBlockProtocolElevation
nodes.description: This policy setting lets you control whether packaged Microsoft Store apps can open URIs using the default desktop app for a URI scheme.

nodes.name: AllowDeploymentInSpecialProfiles
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to manage the deployment of packaged Microsoft Store apps when the user is signed in using a special profile.

nodes.name: AM_EstimateFileHandlerRisk
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure the logic that Windows uses to determine the risk for file attachments.

nodes.name: AM_SetFileRiskLevel
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to manage the default risk level for file types.

nodes.name: AM_SetHighRiskInclusion
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure the list of high-risk file types.

nodes.name: AM_SetLowRiskInclusion
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure the list of low-risk file types.

nodes.name: AM_SetModRiskInclusion
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure the list of moderate-risk file types.

nodes.name: IncludeCmdLine
nodes.description: This policy setting determines what information is logged in security audit events when a new process has been created. This setting only applies when the Audit Process Creation policy is enabled.

nodes.name: BITS_DisableBranchCache
nodes.description: This setting affects whether the BITS client is allowed to use Windows Branch Cache.

nodes.name: BITS_DisablePeercachingClient
nodes.description: This policy setting specifies whether the computer will act as a BITS peer caching client.

nodes.name: BITS_DisablePeercachingServer
nodes.description: This policy setting specifies whether the computer will act as a BITS peer caching server.

nodes.name: BITS_EnablePeercaching
nodes.description: This policy setting determines if the Background Intelligent Transfer Service (BITS) peer caching feature is enabled on a specific computer.

nodes.name: BITS_MaxBandwidthServedForPeers
nodes.description: This policy setting limits the network bandwidth that BITS uses for peer cache transfers (this setting doesn't affect transfers from the origin server).

nodes.name: BITS_MaxBandwidthV2_Maintenance
nodes.description: This policy setting limits the network bandwidth that Background Intelligent Transfer Service (BITS) uses for background transfers during the maintenance days and hours.

nodes.name: BITS_MaxBandwidthV2_Work
nodes.description: This policy setting limits the network bandwidth that Background Intelligent Transfer Service (BITS) uses for background transfers during the work and nonwork days and hours.

nodes.name: BITS_MaxCacheSize
nodes.description: This policy setting limits the maximum amount of disk space that can be used for the BITS peer cache, as a percentage of the total system disk size.

nodes.name: BITS_MaxContentAge
nodes.description: This policy setting limits the maximum age of files in the Background Intelligent Transfer Service (BITS) peer cache.

nodes.name: BITS_MaxDownloadTime
nodes.description: This policy setting limits the amount of time that Background Intelligent Transfer Service (BITS) will take to download the files in a BITS job.

nodes.name: BITS_MaxFilesPerJob
nodes.description: This policy setting limits the number of files that a BITS job can contain. By default, a BITS job is limited to 200 files.

nodes.name: BITS_MaxJobsPerMachine
nodes.description: This policy setting limits the number of BITS jobs that can be created for all users of the computer. By default, BITS limits the total number of jobs that can be created on the computer to 300 jobs.

nodes.name: BITS_MaxJobsPerUser
nodes.description: This policy setting limits the number of BITS jobs that can be created by a user. By default, BITS limits the total number of jobs that can be created by a user to 60 jobs.

nodes.name: BITS_MaxRangesPerFile
nodes.description: This policy setting limits the number of ranges that can be added to a file in a BITS job. By default, files in a BITS job are limited to 500 ranges per file.

nodes.name: AppMgmt_COM_SearchForCLSID_1
nodes.description: This policy setting directs the system to search Active Directory for missing Component Object Model (COM) components that a program requires.

nodes.name: AppMgmt_COM_SearchForCLSID_2
nodes.description: This policy setting directs the system to search Active Directory for missing Component Object Model (COM) components that a program requires.

nodes.name: SSLCipherSuiteOrder
nodes.description: This policy setting determines the cipher suites used by the Secure Socket Layer (SSL). If you enable this policy setting, SSL cipher suites are prioritized in the order specified.

nodes.name: SSLCurveOrder
nodes.description: This policy setting determines the priority order of ECC curves used with ECDHE cipher suites.

nodes.name: DisallowCpls
nodes.description: This setting allows you to display or hide specified Control Panel items, such as Mouse, System, or Personalization, from the Control Panel window and the Start screen.

nodes.name: ForceClassicControlPanel
nodes.description: This policy setting controls the default Control Panel view, whether by category or icons. If this policy setting is enabled, the Control Panel opens to the icon view.

nodes.name: NoControlPanel
nodes.description: Disables all Control Panel programs and the PC settings app. This setting prevents Control.exe and SystemSettings.exe, the program files for Control Panel and PC settings, from starting.

nodes.name: RestrictCpls
nodes.description: This policy setting controls which Control Panel items such as Mouse, System, or Personalization, are displayed on the Control Panel window and the Start screen.

nodes.name: CPL_Display_Disable
nodes.description: Disables the Display Control Panel. If you enable this setting, the Display Control Panel doesn't run. When users try to start Display, a message appears explaining that a setting prevents the action.

nodes.name: CPL_Display_HideSettings
nodes.description: Removes the Settings tab from Display in Control Panel. This setting prevents users from using Control Panel to add, configure, or change the display settings on the computer.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_DisableColorSchemeChoice
nodes.description: This setting forces the theme color scheme to be the default color scheme. If you enable this setting, a user can't change the color scheme of the current desktop theme.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_DisableThemeChange
nodes.description: This setting disables the theme gallery in the Personalization Control Panel. If you enable this setting, users can't change or save a theme.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_DisableVisualStyle
nodes.description: Prevents users or applications from changing the visual style of the windows and buttons displayed on their screens.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_EnableScreenSaver
nodes.description: Enables desktop screen savers. If you disable this setting, screen savers don't run.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_ForceDefaultLockScreen
nodes.description: This setting allows you to force a specific default lock screen and logon image by entering the path (location) of the image file. The same image will be used for both the lock and logon screens.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_LockFontSize
nodes.description: Prevents users from changing the size of the font in the windows and buttons displayed on their screens.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_NoChangingLockScreen
nodes.description: Prevents users from changing the background image shown when the machine is locked or when on the logon screen.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_NoChangingStartMenuBackground
nodes.description: Prevents users from changing the look of their start menu background, such as its color or accent. By default, users can change the look of their start menu background, such as its color or accent.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_NoColorAppearanceUI
nodes.description: Disables the Color (or Window Color) page in the Personalization Control Panel, or the Color Scheme dialog in the Display Control Panel on systems where the Personalization feature isn't available.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_NoDesktopBackgroundUI
nodes.description: Prevents users from adding or changing the background design of the desktop.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_NoDesktopIconsUI
nodes.description: Prevents users from changing the desktop icons. By default, users can use the Desktop Icon Settings dialog in the Personalization or Display Control Panel to show, hide, or change the desktop icons.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_NoLockScreen
nodes.description: This policy setting controls whether the lock screen appears for users.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_NoMousePointersUI
nodes.description: Prevents users from changing the mouse pointers. By default, users can use the Pointers tab in the Mouse Control Panel to add, remove, or change the mouse pointers.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_NoScreenSaverUI
nodes.description: Prevents the Screen Saver dialog from opening in the Personalization or Display Control Panel.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_NoSoundSchemeUI
nodes.description: Prevents users from changing the sound scheme. By default, users can use the Sounds tab in the Sound Control Panel to add, remove, or change the system Sound Scheme.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_PersonalColors
nodes.description: Forces Windows to use the specified colors for the background and accent. The color values are specified in hex as #RGB. By default, users can change the background and accent colors.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_ScreenSaverIsSecure
nodes.description: Determines whether screen savers used on the computer are password protected. If you enable this setting, all screen savers are password protected.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_ScreenSaverTimeOut
nodes.description: Specifies how much user idle time must elapse before the screen saver is launched. When configured, this idle time can be set from a minimum of 1 second to a maximum of 86,400 seconds, or 24 hours.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_SetScreenSaver
nodes.description: Specifies the screen saver for the user's desktop. If you enable this setting, the system displays the specified screen saver on the user's desktop.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_SetTheme
nodes.description: Specifies which theme file is applied to the computer the first time a user logs on. If you enable this setting, the theme that you specify will be applied when a new user logs on for the first time.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_SetVisualStyle
nodes.description: This setting allows you to force a specific visual style file by entering the path (location) of the visual style file.

nodes.name: CPL_Personalization_StartBackground
nodes.description: Forces the Start screen to use one of the available backgrounds, 1 through 20, and prevents the user from changing it.

nodes.name: UseDefaultTile
nodes.description: This policy setting allows an administrator to standardize the account pictures for all users on a system to the default account picture.

nodes.name: AllowDefCredentialsWhenNTLMOnly
nodes.description: This policy setting applies to applications using the Cred SSP component (for example: Remote Desktop Connection).

nodes.name: AllowDefaultCredentials
nodes.description: This policy setting applies to applications using the Cred SSP component (for example: Remote Desktop Connection).

nodes.name: AllowEncryptionOracle
nodes.description: Encryption Oracle Remediation. This policy setting applies to applications using the CredSSP component (for example: Remote Desktop Connection).

nodes.name: AllowFreshCredentials
nodes.description: This policy setting applies to applications using the Cred SSP component (for example: Remote Desktop Connection).

nodes.name: AllowFreshCredentialsWhenNTLMOnly
nodes.description: This policy setting applies to applications using the Cred SSP component (for example: Remote Desktop Connection).

nodes.name: AllowSavedCredentials
nodes.description: This policy setting applies to applications using the Cred SSP component (for example: Remote Desktop Connection).

nodes.name: AllowSavedCredentialsWhenNTLMOnly
nodes.description: This policy setting applies to applications using the Cred SSP component (for example: Remote Desktop Connection).

nodes.name: DenyDefaultCredentials
nodes.description: This policy setting applies to applications using the Cred SSP component (for example: Remote Desktop Connection).

nodes.name: DenyFreshCredentials
nodes.description: This policy setting applies to applications using the Cred SSP component (for example: Remote Desktop Connection).

nodes.name: DenySavedCredentials
nodes.description: This policy setting applies to applications using the Cred SSP component (for example: Remote Desktop Connection).

nodes.name: RestrictedRemoteAdministration
nodes.description: When running in Restricted Admin or Remote Credential Guard mode, participating apps don't expose signed in or supplied credentials to a remote host.

nodes.name: EnableSecureCredentialPrompting
nodes.description: This policy setting requires the user to enter Microsoft Windows credentials using a trusted path, to prevent a Trojan horse or other types of malicious code from stealing the user's Windows…

nodes.name: NoLocalPasswordResetQuestions
nodes.description: If you turn this policy setting on, local users won't be able to set up and use security questions to reset their passwords.

nodes.name: AllowDomainDelayLock
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to control whether a user can change the time before a password is required when a Connected Standby device screen turns off.

nodes.name: DefaultCredentialProvider
nodes.description: This policy setting allows the administrator to assign a specified credential provider as the default credential provider.

nodes.name: ExcludedCredentialProviders
nodes.description: This policy setting allows the administrator to exclude the specified credential providers from use during authentication.

nodes.name: DisableChangePassword
nodes.description: This policy setting prevents users from changing their Windows password on demand.

nodes.name: DisableLockComputer
nodes.description: This policy setting prevents users from locking the system. While locked, the desktop is hidden and the system can't be used.

nodes.name: DisableTaskMgr
nodes.description: This policy setting prevents users from starting Task Manager.

nodes.name: NoLogoff
nodes.description: This policy setting disables or removes all menu items and buttons that log the user off the system.

nodes.name: DCOMActivationSecurityCheckAllowLocalList
nodes.description: Allows you to specify that local computer administrators can supplement the "Define Activation Security Check exemptions" list.

nodes.name: DCOMActivationSecurityCheckExemptionList
nodes.description: Allows you to view and change a list of DCOM server application ids (appids) which are exempted from the DCOM Activation security check.

nodes.name: DFSDiscoverDC
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure how often a Distributed File System (DFS) client attempts to discover domain controllers on a network.

nodes.name: DwmDefaultColorizationColor_1
nodes.description: This policy setting controls the default color for window frames when the user doesn't specify a color.

nodes.name: DwmDefaultColorizationColor_2
nodes.description: This policy setting controls the default color for window frames when the user doesn't specify a color.

nodes.name: DwmDisallowAnimations_1
nodes.description: This policy setting controls the appearance of window animations such as those found when restoring, minimizing, and maximizing windows.

nodes.name: DwmDisallowAnimations_2
nodes.description: This policy setting controls the appearance of window animations such as those found when restoring, minimizing, and maximizing windows.

nodes.name: DwmDisallowColorizationColorChanges_1
nodes.description: This policy setting controls the ability to change the color of window frames. If you enable this policy setting, you prevent users from changing the default window frame color.

nodes.name: DwmDisallowColorizationColorChanges_2
nodes.description: This policy setting controls the ability to change the color of window frames. If you enable this policy setting, you prevent users from changing the default window frame color.

nodes.name: CommercialIdPolicy
nodes.description: This policy setting defines the identifier used to uniquely associate this device's diagnostic data data as belonging to a given organization.

nodes.name: AD_EnableFilter
nodes.description: Displays the filter bar above the results of an Active Directory search. The filter bar consists of buttons for applying additional filters to search results.

nodes.name: AD_HideDirectoryFolder
nodes.description: Hides the Active Directory folder in Network Locations. The Active Directory folder displays Active Directory objects in a browse window.

nodes.name: AD_QueryLimit
nodes.description: Specifies the maximum number of objects the system displays in response to a command to browse or search Active Directory.

nodes.name: EnableThemeFileRemoteResource
nodes.description: This policy setting determines whether remote paths can be used for resources inside of a Windows desktop theme (.theme/.themepack) file.

nodes.name: ForceActiveDesktopOn
nodes.description: Enables Active Desktop and prevents users from disabling it. This setting prevents users from trying to enable or disable Active Desktop while a policy controls it.

nodes.name: NoActiveDesktop
nodes.description: Disables Active Desktop and prevents users from enabling it. This setting prevents users from trying to enable or disable Active Desktop while a policy controls it.

nodes.name: NoActiveDesktopChanges
nodes.description: Prevents the user from enabling or disabling Active Desktop or changing the Active Desktop configuration.

nodes.name: NoDesktop
nodes.description: Removes icons, shortcuts, and other default and user-defined items from the desktop, including Briefcase, Recycle Bin, Computer, and Network Locations.

nodes.name: NoDesktopCleanupWizard
nodes.description: Prevents users from using the Desktop Cleanup Wizard. If you enable this setting, the Desktop Cleanup wizard doesn't automatically run on a users workstation every 60 days.

nodes.name: NoInternetIcon
nodes.description: Removes the Internet Explorer icon from the desktop and from the Quick Launch bar on the taskbar. This setting doesn't prevent the user from starting Internet Explorer by using other methods.

nodes.name: NoMyComputerIcon
nodes.description: This setting hides Computer from the desktop and from the new Start menu.

nodes.name: NoMyDocumentsIcon
nodes.description: Removes most occurrences of the My Documents icon.

nodes.name: NoNetHood
nodes.description: Removes the Network Locations icon from the desktop. This setting only affects the desktop icon.

nodes.name: NoPropertiesMyComputer
nodes.description: This setting hides Properties on the context menu for Computer.

nodes.name: NoPropertiesMyDocuments
nodes.description: This policy setting hides the Properties menu command on the shortcut menu for the My Documents icon.

nodes.name: NoRecentDocsNetHood
nodes.description: Remote shared folders aren't added to Network Locations whenever you open a document in the shared folder.

nodes.name: NoRecycleBinIcon
nodes.description: Removes most occurrences of the Recycle Bin icon.

nodes.name: NoRecycleBinProperties
nodes.description: Removes the Properties option from the Recycle Bin context menu.

nodes.name: NoSaveSettings
nodes.description: Prevents users from saving certain changes to the desktop.

nodes.name: NoWindowMinimizingShortcuts
nodes.description: Prevents windows from being minimized or restored when the active window is shaken back and forth with the mouse.

nodes.name: Wallpaper
nodes.description: Specifies the desktop background ("wallpaper") displayed on all users' desktops.

nodes.name: sz_ATC_DisableAdd
nodes.description: Prevents users from adding Web content to their Active Desktop. This setting removes the "New" button from Web tab in Display in Control Panel.

nodes.name: sz_ATC_DisableClose
nodes.description: Prevents users from removing Web content from their Active Desktop. In Active Desktop, you can add items to the desktop but close them so they aren't displayed.

nodes.name: sz_ATC_DisableDel
nodes.description: Prevents users from deleting Web content from their Active Desktop. This setting removes the Delete button from the Web tab in Display in Control Panel.

nodes.name: sz_ATC_DisableEdit
nodes.description: Prevents users from changing the properties of Web content items on their Active Desktop. This setting disables the Properties button on the Web tab in Display in Control Panel.

nodes.name: sz_ATC_NoComponents
nodes.description: Removes Active Desktop content and prevents users from adding Active Desktop content. This setting removes all Active Desktop items from the desktop.

nodes.name: sz_AdminComponents_Title
nodes.description: Adds and deletes specified Web content items. You can use the "Add" box in this setting to add particular Web-based items or shortcuts to users' desktops.

nodes.name: sz_DB_DragDropClose
nodes.description: Prevents users from manipulating desktop toolbars. If you enable this setting, users can't add or remove toolbars from the desktop. Also, users can't drag toolbars on to or off of docked toolbars.

nodes.name: sz_DB_Moving
nodes.description: Prevents users from adjusting the length of desktop toolbars. Also, users can't reposition items or toolbars on docked toolbars.

nodes.name: sz_DWP_NoHTMLPaper
nodes.description: Permits only bitmap images for wallpaper. This setting limits the desktop background ("wallpaper") to bitmap (.bmp) files.

nodes.name: DeviceFlags
nodes.description: Changes behavior of Microsoft bus drivers to work with specific devices.

nodes.name: DriverShims
nodes.description: Changes behavior of 3rd-party drivers to work around incompatibilities introduced between OS versions.

nodes.name: ConfigCIPolicy
nodes.description: Deploy App Control for Business. This policy setting lets you deploy a Code Integrity Policy to a machine to control what's allowed to run on that machine.

nodes.name: DeviceInstall_AllowAdminInstall
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to determine whether members of the Administrators group can install and update the drivers for any device, regardless of other policy settings.

nodes.name: DeviceInstall_DeniedPolicy_DetailText
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to display a custom message to users in a notification when a device installation is attempted and a policy setting prevents the installation.

nodes.name: DeviceInstall_DeniedPolicy_SimpleText
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to display a custom message title in a notification when a device installation is attempted and a policy setting prevents the installation.

nodes.name: DeviceInstall_InstallTimeout
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure the number of seconds Windows waits for a device installation task to complete.

nodes.name: DeviceInstall_Policy_RebootTime
nodes.description: This policy setting establishes the amount of time (in seconds) that the system will wait to reboot in order to enforce a change in device installation restriction policies.

nodes.name: DeviceInstall_Removable_Deny
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to prevent Windows from installing removable devices.

nodes.name: DeviceInstall_SystemRestore
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to prevent Windows from creating a system restore point during device activity that would normally prompt Windows to create a system restore point.

nodes.name: DriverInstall_Classes_AllowUser
nodes.description: This policy setting specifies a list of device setup class GUIDs describing driver packages that non-administrator members of the built-in Users group may install on the system.

nodes.name: DeviceInstall_BalloonTips
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to turn off "Found New Hardware" balloons during device installation.

nodes.name: DriverSearchPlaces_SearchOrderConfiguration
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to specify the order in which Windows searches source locations for device drivers.

nodes.name: Digitalx_DiableApplication_TitleText_1
nodes.description: Specifies whether Digital Locker can run.

nodes.name: Digitalx_DiableApplication_TitleText_2
nodes.description: Specifies whether Digital Locker can run.

nodes.name: DfdAlertPolicy
nodes.description: This policy setting substitutes custom alert text in the disk diagnostic message shown to users when a disk reports a S.M.A.R.T. fault.

nodes.name: WdiScenarioExecutionPolicy
nodes.description: This policy setting determines the execution level for S.M.A.R.T.-based disk diagnostics.

nodes.name: BootResumePolicy
nodes.description: This policy setting turns off the boot and resume optimizations for the hybrid hard disks in the system.

nodes.name: CachePowerModePolicy
nodes.description: This policy setting turns off power save mode on the hybrid hard disks in the system.

nodes.name: FeatureOffPolicy
nodes.description: This policy setting turns off all support for the non-volatile (NV) cache on all hybrid hard disks in the system.

nodes.name: SolidStatePolicy
nodes.description: This policy setting turns off the solid state mode for the hybrid hard disks.

nodes.name: DQ_Enable
nodes.description: This policy setting turns on and turns off disk quota management on all NTFS volumes of the computer, and prevents users from changing the setting.

nodes.name: DQ_Enforce
nodes.description: This policy setting determines whether disk quota limits are enforced and prevents users from changing the setting. If you enable this policy setting, disk quota limits are enforced.

nodes.name: DQ_Limit
nodes.description: This policy setting specifies the default disk quota limit and warning level for new users of the volume.

nodes.name: DQ_LogEventOverLimit
nodes.description: This policy setting determines whether the system records an event in the local Application log when users reach their disk quota limit on a volume, and prevents users from changing the logging…

nodes.name: DQ_LogEventOverThreshold
nodes.description: This policy setting determines whether the system records an event in the Application log when users reach their disk quota warning level on a volume.

nodes.name: DQ_RemovableMedia
nodes.description: This policy setting extends the disk quota policies in this folder to NTFS file system volumes on removable media.

nodes.name: DLT_AllowDomainMode
nodes.description: Specifies that Distributed Link Tracking clients in this domain may use the Distributed Link Tracking (DLT) server, which runs on domain controllers.

nodes.name: DNS_AllowFQDNNetBiosQueries
nodes.description: Specifies that NetBIOS over TCP/IP (NetBT) queries are issued for fully qualified domain names.

nodes.name: DNS_AppendToMultiLabelName
nodes.description: Specifies that the DNS client may attach suffixes to an unqualified multi-label name before sending subsequent DNS queries if the original name query fails.

nodes.name: DNS_Domain
nodes.description: Specifies a connection-specific DNS suffix.

nodes.name: DNS_DomainNameDevolutionLevel
nodes.description: Specifies if the devolution level that DNS clients will use if they perform primary DNS suffix devolution during the name resolution process.

nodes.name: DNS_IdnEncoding
nodes.description: Specifies whether the DNS client should convert internationalized domain names (IDNs) to Punycode when the DNS client is on non-domain networks with no WINS servers configured.

nodes.name: DNS_IdnMapping
nodes.description: Specifies whether the DNS client should convert internationalized domain names (IDNs) to the Nameprep form, a canonical Unicode representation of the string.

nodes.name: DNS_NameServer
nodes.description: Defines the DNS servers to which the DNS client sends queries when it attempts to resolve names.

nodes.name: DNS_Netbios
nodes.description: Specifies if the DNS client will perform name resolution over NetBIOS. By default, the DNS client will disable NetBIOS name resolution on public networks for security reasons.

nodes.name: DNS_PreferLocalResponsesOverLowerOrderDns
nodes.description: Specifies that responses from link local name resolution protocols received over a network interface that's higher in the binding order are preferred over DNS responses from network interfaces lower…

nodes.name: DNS_PrimaryDnsSuffix
nodes.description: Specifies the primary DNS suffix used by the DNS client in DNS name registration and DNS name resolution.

nodes.name: DNS_RegisterAdapterName
nodes.description: Specifies if the DNS client performing dynamic DNS registration will register A and PTR resource records with a concatenation of its computer name and a connection-specific DNS suffix, in addition to…

nodes.name: DNS_RegisterReverseLookup
nodes.description: Specifies if the DNS client will register PTR resource records.

nodes.name: DNS_RegistrationEnabled
nodes.description: Specifies if DNS dynamic update is enabled. DNS clients configured for DNS dynamic update automatically register and update their DNS resource records with a DNS server.

nodes.name: DNS_RegistrationOverwritesInConflict
nodes.description: Specifies whether dynamic updates should overwrite existing resource records that contain conflicting IP addresses.

nodes.name: DNS_RegistrationRefreshInterval
nodes.description: Specifies the interval used by DNS clients to refresh registration of A and PTR resource. This policy setting only applies DNS clients performing dynamic DNS updates.

nodes.name: DNS_RegistrationTtl
nodes.description: Specifies the value of the time to live (TTL) field in A and PTR resource records that are registered by the DNS client to which this policy setting is applied.

nodes.name: DNS_SearchList
nodes.description: Specifies the DNS suffixes to attach to an unqualified single-label name before submission of a DNS query for that name. An unqualified single-label name contains no dots.

nodes.name: DNS_SmartMultiHomedNameResolution
nodes.description: Specifies that a multi-homed DNS client should optimize name resolution across networks.

nodes.name: DNS_SmartProtocolReorder
nodes.description: Specifies that the DNS client should prefer responses from link local name resolution protocols on non-domain networks over DNS responses when issuing queries for flat names.

nodes.name: DNS_UpdateSecurityLevel
nodes.description: Specifies the security level for dynamic DNS updates.

nodes.name: DNS_UpdateTopLevelDomainZones
nodes.description: Specifies if the DNS client may send dynamic updates to zones with a single label name.

nodes.name: DNS_UseDomainNameDevolution
nodes.description: Specifies if the DNS client performs primary DNS suffix devolution during the name resolution process.

nodes.name: Turn_Off_Multicast
nodes.description: Specifies that link local multicast name resolution (LLMNR) is disabled on the DNS client. LLMNR is a secondary name resolution protocol.

nodes.name: L_DoNotIncludeNonPublishingStandardGlyphInTheCandidateList
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to include the Non-Publishing Standard Glyph in the candidate list when Publishing Standard Glyph for the word exists.

nodes.name: L_RestrictCharacterCodeRangeOfConversion
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to restrict character code range of conversion by setting character filter.

nodes.name: L_TurnOffCustomDictionary
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to turn off the ability to use a custom dictionary.

nodes.name: L_TurnOffHistorybasedPredictiveInput
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to turn off history-based predictive input. If you enable this policy setting, history-based predictive input is turned off.

nodes.name: L_TurnOffInternetSearchIntegration
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to turn off Internet search integration.

nodes.name: L_TurnOffOpenExtendedDictionary

nodes.description: This policy setting configures Microsoft Support Diagnostic Tool (MSDT) interactive communication with the support provider. MSDT gathers diagnostic data for analysis by support professionals.

nodes.description: This policy setting restricts the tool download policy for Microsoft Support Diagnostic Tool. Microsoft Support Diagnostic Tool (MSDT) gathers diagnostic data for analysis by support professionals.

nodes.name: WdiScenarioExecutionPolicy
nodes.description: This policy setting determines the execution level for Microsoft Support Diagnostic Tool. Microsoft Support Diagnostic Tool (MSDT) gathers diagnostic data for analysis by support professionals.

nodes.name: AllowLockdownBrowse
nodes.description: This policy setting allows users to search for installation files during privileged installations. If you enable this policy setting, the Browse button in the "Use feature from" dialog box is enabled.

nodes.name: AllowLockdownMedia
nodes.description: This policy setting allows users to install programs from removable media during privileged installations.

nodes.name: AllowLockdownPatch
nodes.description: This policy setting allows users to patch elevated products.

nodes.name: DisableAutomaticApplicationShutdown
nodes.description: This policy setting controls Windows Installer's interaction with the Restart Manager.

nodes.name: DisableBrowse
nodes.description: This policy setting prevents users from searching for installation files when they add features or components to an installed program.

nodes.name: DisableFlyweightPatching
nodes.description: This policy setting controls the ability to turn off all patch optimizations. If you enable this policy setting, all Patch Optimization options are turned off during the installation.

nodes.name: DisableLoggingFromPackage
nodes.description: This policy setting controls Windows Installer's processing of the MsiLogging property.

nodes.name: DisableMSI
nodes.description: This policy setting restricts the use of Windows Installer.

nodes.name: DisableMedia
nodes.description: This policy setting prevents users from installing any programs from removable media.

nodes.name: DisablePatch
nodes.description: This policy setting prevents users from using Windows Installer to install patches. If you enable this policy setting, users are prevented from using Windows Installer to install patches.

nodes.name: DisableRollback_1
nodes.description: This policy setting prohibits Windows Installer from generating and saving the files it needs to reverse an interrupted or unsuccessful installation.

nodes.name: DisableRollback_2
nodes.description: This policy setting prohibits Windows Installer from generating and saving the files it needs to reverse an interrupted or unsuccessful installation.

nodes.name: DisableSharedComponent
nodes.description: This policy setting controls the ability to turn off shared components.

nodes.name: MSILogging
nodes.description: Specifies the types of events that Windows Installer records in its transaction log for each installation. The log, Msi.log, appears in the Temp directory of the system volume.

nodes.name: MSI_DisableLUAPatching
nodes.description: This policy setting controls the ability of non-administrators to install updates that have been digitally signed by the application vendor.

nodes.name: MSI_DisablePatchUninstall
nodes.description: This policy setting controls the ability for users or administrators to remove Windows Installer based updates. This policy setting should be used if you need to maintain a tight control over updates.

nodes.name: MSI_DisableSRCheckPoints
nodes.description: This policy setting prevents Windows Installer from creating a System Restore checkpoint each time an application is installed.

nodes.name: MSI_DisableUserInstalls
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure user installs. To configure this policy setting, set it to enabled and use the drop-down list to select the behavior you want.

nodes.name: MSI_EnforceUpgradeComponentRules
nodes.description: This policy setting causes the Windows Installer to enforce strict rules for component upgrades.

nodes.name: MSI_MaxPatchCacheSize
nodes.description: This policy controls the percentage of disk space available to the Windows Installer baseline file cache.

nodes.name: MsiDisableEmbeddedUI
nodes.description: This policy setting controls the ability to prevent embedded UI. If you enable this policy setting, no packages on the system can run embedded UI. If you disable or don't configure this policy…

nodes.name: SafeForScripting
nodes.description: This policy setting allows Web-based programs to install software on the computer without notifying the user.

nodes.name: SearchOrder
nodes.description: This policy setting specifies the order in which Windows Installer searches for installation files.

nodes.name: TransformsSecure
nodes.description: This policy setting saves copies of transform files in a secure location on the local computer. Transform files consist of instructions to modify or customize a program during installation.

nodes.name: Pol_MSS_AutoAdminLogon
nodes.description: Enable Automatic Logon (not recommended).

nodes.name: Pol_MSS_AutoReboot
nodes.description: Allow Windows to automatically restart after a system crash (recommended except for highly secure environments).

nodes.name: Pol_MSS_AutoShareServer
nodes.description: Enable administrative shares on servers (recommended except for highly secure environments).

nodes.name: Pol_MSS_AutoShareWks
nodes.description: Enable administrative shares on workstations (recommended except for highly secure environments).

nodes.name: Pol_MSS_EnableDeadGWDetect
nodes.description: Allow automatic detection of dead network gateways (could lead to DoS).

nodes.name: Pol_MSS_HideFromBrowseList
nodes.description: Hide Computer From the Browse List (not recommended except for highly secure environments).

nodes.name: Pol_MSS_KeepAliveTime
nodes.description: Define how often keep-alive packets are sent in milliseconds.

nodes.name: Pol_MSS_NoDefaultExempt
nodes.description: Configure IPSec exemptions for various types of network traffic.

nodes.name: Pol_MSS_NtfsDisable8dot3NameCreation
nodes.description: Enable the computer to stop generating 8.3 style filenames.

nodes.name: Pol_MSS_PerformRouterDiscovery
nodes.description: Allow IRDP to detect and configure Default Gateway addresses (could lead to DoS).

nodes.name: Pol_MSS_SafeDllSearchMode
nodes.description: Enable Safe DLL search mode (recommended).

nodes.name: Pol_MSS_ScreenSaverGracePeriod
nodes.description: he time in seconds before the screen saver grace period expires (0 recommended).

nodes.name: Pol_MSS_SynAttackProtect
nodes.description: Syn attack protection level (protects against DoS).

nodes.name: Pol_MSS_TcpMaxConnectResponseRetransmissions
nodes.description: SYN-ACK retransmissions when a connection request is not acknowledged.

nodes.name: Pol_MSS_TcpMaxDataRetransmissions
nodes.description: Define how many times unacknowledged data is retransmitted (3 recommended, 5 is default).

nodes.name: Pol_MSS_TcpMaxDataRetransmissionsIPv6
nodes.description: Define how many times unacknowledged data is retransmitted (3 recommended, 5 is default).

nodes.name: Pol_MSS_WarningLevel
nodes.description: Percentage threshold for the security event log at which the system will generate a warning.

nodes.name: AllowFastServiceStartup
nodes.description: This policy setting controls the load priority for the antimalware service. Increasing the load priority will allow for faster service startup, but may impact performance.

nodes.name: DisableAntiSpywareDefender
nodes.description: This policy setting turns off Microsoft Defender Antivirus.

nodes.name: DisableAutoExclusions

nodes.name: DisableBlockAtFirstSeen
nodes.description: This feature ensures the device checks in real time with the Microsoft Active Protection Service (MAPS) before allowing certain content to be run or accessed.

nodes.name: DisableLocalAdminMerge
nodes.description: This policy setting controls whether or not complex list settings configured by a local administrator are merged with Group Policy settings.

nodes.name: DisableRealtimeMonitoring
nodes.description: This policy turns off real-time protection in Microsoft Defender Antivirus. Real-time protection consists of always-on scanning with file and process behavior monitoring and heuristics.

nodes.name: DisableRoutinelyTakingAction
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure whether Microsoft Defender Antivirus automatically takes action on all detected threats.

nodes.name: Exclusions_Extensions
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you specify a list of file types that should be excluded from scheduled, custom, and real-time scanning. File types should be added under the Options for this setting.

nodes.name: Exclusions_Paths
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to disable scheduled and real-time scanning for files under the paths specified or for the fully qualified resources specified.

nodes.name: Exclusions_Processes
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to disable real-time scanning for any file opened by any of the specified processes. This policy doesn't apply to scheduled scans. The process itself won't be excluded.

nodes.name: ExploitGuard_ASR_ASROnlyExclusions
nodes.description: Exclude files and paths from Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) rules. Enabled: Specify the folders or files and resources that should be excluded from ASR rules in the Options section.

nodes.name: ExploitGuard_ASR_Rules
nodes.description: Set the state for each Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) rule.

nodes.name: ExploitGuard_ControlledFolderAccess_AllowedApplications
nodes.description: Add additional applications that should be considered "trusted" by controlled folder access. These applications are allowed to modify or delete files in controlled folder access folders.

nodes.name: ExploitGuard_ControlledFolderAccess_ProtectedFolders
nodes.description: Specify additional folders that should be guarded by the Controlled folder access feature. Files in these folders can't be modified or deleted by untrusted applications.

nodes.name: MpEngine_EnableFileHashComputation
nodes.description: Enable or disable file hash computation feature. Enabled: When this feature is enabled Microsoft Defender will compute hash value for files it scans. Disabled: File hash value isn't computed.

nodes.name: Nis_Consumers_IPS_DisableSignatureRetirement

nodes.description: Shows or hides sleep from the power options menu. If you enable this policy setting, the sleep option will be shown in the Power Options menu (as long as it's supported by the machine's hardware).

nodes.name: TryHarderPinnedLibrary
nodes.description: This policy setting allows up to five Libraries or Search Connectors to be pinned to the "Search again" links and the Start menu links.

nodes.name: TryHarderPinnedOpenSearch
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to add Internet or intranet sites to the "Search again" links located at the bottom of search results in File Explorer and the Start menu links.

nodes.name: DisableOnline
nodes.description: Prevents Windows Media Digital Rights Management (DRM) from accessing the Internet (or intranet).

nodes.name: ConfigureHTTPProxySettings
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to specify the HTTP proxy settings for Windows Media Player.

nodes.name: ConfigureMMSProxySettings
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to specify the MMS proxy settings for Windows Media Player.

nodes.name: ConfigureRTSPProxySettings
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to specify the RTSP proxy settings for Windows Media Player.

nodes.name: DisableAutoUpdate
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to turn off don't show first use dialog boxes.

nodes.name: DisableNetworkSettings
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to hide the Network tab. If you enable this policy setting, the Network tab in Windows Media Player is hidden.

nodes.name: DisableSetupFirstUseConfiguration
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to prevent the anchor window from being displayed when Windows Media Player is in skin mode.

nodes.name: DoNotShowAnchor
nodes.description: Prevents the anchor window from being displayed when Windows Media Player is in skin mode. This policy hides the anchor window when the Player is in skin mode.

nodes.name: DontUseFrameInterpolation
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to prevent video smoothing from occurring.

nodes.name: EnableScreenSaver
nodes.description: This policy setting allows a screen saver to interrupt playback.

nodes.name: HidePrivacyTab
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to hide the Privacy tab in Windows Media Player.

nodes.name: HideSecurityTab
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to hide the Security tab in Windows Media Player.

nodes.name: NetworkBuffering
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to specify whether network buffering uses the default or a specified number of seconds.

nodes.name: PolicyCodecUpdate
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to prevent Windows Media Player from downloading codecs.

nodes.name: PreventCDDVDMetadataRetrieval
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to prevent media information for CDs and DVDs from being retrieved from the Internet.

nodes.name: PreventLibrarySharing
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to prevent media sharing from Windows Media Player.

nodes.name: PreventMusicFileMetadataRetrieval
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to prevent media information for music files from being retrieved from the Internet.

nodes.name: PreventQuickLaunchShortcut
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to prevent a shortcut for the Player from being added to the Quick Launch bar.

nodes.name: PreventRadioPresetsRetrieval
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to prevent radio station presets from being retrieved from the Internet.

nodes.name: PreventWMPDeskTopShortcut
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to prevent a shortcut icon for the Player from being added to the user's desktop.

nodes.name: SkinLockDown
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to set and lock Windows Media Player in skin mode, using a specified skin.

nodes.name: WindowsStreamingMediaProtocols
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to specify that Windows Media Player can attempt to use selected protocols when receiving streaming media from a server running Windows Media Services.

nodes.name: DisallowKerberos_1
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to manage whether the Windows Remote Management (WinRM) service accepts Kerberos credentials over the network.

nodes.name: DisallowKerberos_2
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to manage whether the Windows Remote Management (WinRM) client uses Kerberos authentication directly.

nodes.name: DisableAutoDownloadWin8
nodes.description: Enables or disables the automatic download of app updates on PCs running Windows 8. If you enable this setting, the automatic download of app updates is turned off.

nodes.name: DisableOSUpgrade_1
nodes.description: Enables or disables the Store offer to update to the latest version of Windows. If you enable this setting, the Store application won't offer updates to the latest version of Windows.

nodes.name: DisableOSUpgrade_2
nodes.description: Enables or disables the Store offer to update to the latest version of Windows. If you enable this setting, the Store application won't offer updates to the latest version of Windows.

nodes.name: RemoveWindowsStore_1
nodes.description: Denies or allows access to the Store application. If you enable this setting, access to the Store application is denied. Access to the Store is required for installing app updates.

nodes.name: RemoveWindowsStore_2
nodes.description: Denies or allows access to the Store application. If you enable this setting, access to the Store application is denied. Access to the Store is required for installing app updates.

nodes.name: AllowBlockingAppsAtShutdown
nodes.description: Note This policy setting applies to all sites in Trusted zones.

nodes.name: CustomSearch
nodes.description: Set up the menu name and URL for the custom Internet search provider. If you enable this setting, the specified menu name and URL will be used for Internet searches.

nodes.name: Pol_MachineEnableWorkFolders
nodes.description: This policy setting specifies whether Work Folders should be set up automatically for all users of the affected computer.

nodes.name: Pol_UserEnableTokenBroker
nodes.description: This policy specifies whether Work Folders should use Token Broker for interactive AD FS authentication instead of its own OAuth2 token flow used in previous versions.

nodes.name: Pol_UserEnableWorkFolders
nodes.description: This policy setting specifies the Work Folders server for affected users, as well as whether or not users are allowed to change settings when setting up Work Folders on a domain-joined computer.

nodes.name: WdiScenarioExecutionPolicy
nodes.description: This policy setting permits or prohibits the Diagnostic Policy Service (DPS) from automatically resolving any heap corruption problems.

nodes.name: HotspotAuth_Enable
nodes.description: This policy setting defines whether WLAN hotspots are probed for Wireless Internet Service Provider roaming (WISPr) protocol support.

nodes.name: iSCSIDiscovery_ConfigureTargetPortals
nodes.description: If enabled then new target portals may not be added and thus new targets discovered on those portals; existing target portals may not be removed.

nodes.name: iSCSIDiscovery_ConfigureTargets
nodes.description: If enabled then discovered targets may not be manually configured. If disabled then discovered targets may be manually configured. Note if enabled there may be cases where this will break VDS.

nodes.name: iSCSIDiscovery_ConfigureiSNSServers
nodes.description: If enabled then new iSNS servers may not be added and thus new targets discovered via those iSNS servers; existing iSNS servers may not be removed.

nodes.name: iSCSIDiscovery_NewStaticTargets
nodes.description: If enabled then new targets may not be manually configured by entering the target name and target portal; already discovered targets may be manually configured.

nodes.name: iSCSIGeneral_ChangeIQNName
nodes.description: If enabled then don't allow the initiator iqn name to be changed. If disabled then the initiator iqn name may be changed.

nodes.name: iSCSIGeneral_RestrictAdditionalLogins
nodes.description: If enabled then only those sessions that are established via a persistent login will be established and no new persistent logins may be created.

nodes.name: iSCSISecurity_ChangeCHAPSecret
nodes.description: If enabled then don't allow the initiator CHAP secret to be changed. If disabled then the initiator CHAP secret may be changed.

nodes.name: iSCSISecurity_RequireIPSec
nodes.description: If enabled then only those connections that are configured for IPSec may be established.

nodes.name: iSCSISecurity_RequireMutualCHAP
nodes.description: If enabled then only those sessions that are configured for mutual CHAP may be established.

nodes.name: iSCSISecurity_RequireOneWayCHAP
nodes.description: If enabled then only those sessions that are configured for one-way CHAP may be established.

nodes.name: CbacAndArmor
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure a domain controller to support claims and compound authentication for Dynamic Access Control and Kerberos armoring using Kerberos authentication.

nodes.name: ForestSearch
nodes.description: This policy setting defines the list of trusting forests that the Key Distribution Center (KDC) searches when attempting to resolve two-part service principal names (SPNs).

nodes.name: PKINITFreshness
nodes.description: Support for PKInit Freshness Extension requires Windows Server 2016 domain functional level (DFL).

nodes.name: RequestCompoundId
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure a domain controller to request compound authentication.

nodes.name: TicketSizeThreshold
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure at what size Kerberos tickets will trigger the warning event issued during Kerberos authentication. The ticket size warnings are logged in the System log.

nodes.name: emitlili
nodes.description: This policy setting controls whether the domain controller provides information about previous logons to client computers.

nodes.name: ActivationBoundaryPolicy
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure Automatic Maintenance activation boundary. The maintenance activation boundary is the daily schduled time at which Automatic Maintenance starts.

nodes.name: RandomDelayPolicy
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure Automatic Maintenance activation random delay.

nodes.name: CorporateResources
nodes.description: Specifies resources on your intranet that are normally accessible to DirectAccess clients. Each entry is a string that identifies the type of resource and the location of the resource.

nodes.name: CustomCommands
nodes.description: Specifies commands configured by the administrator for custom logging. These commands will run in addition to default log commands.

nodes.name: DTEs
nodes.description: Specifies the IPv6 addresses of the endpoints of the Internet Protocol security (IPsec) tunnels that enable DirectAccess.

nodes.name: FriendlyName
nodes.description: Specifies the string that appears for DirectAccess connectivity when the user clicks the Networking notification area icon.

nodes.name: LocalNamesOn
nodes.description: Specifies whether the user has Connect and Disconnect options for the DirectAccess entry when the user clicks the Networking notification area icon.

nodes.name: PassiveMode
nodes.description: Specifies whether NCA service runs in Passive Mode or not. Set this to Disabled to keep NCA probing actively all the time. If this setting isn't configured, NCA probing is in active mode by default.

nodes.name: ShowUI
nodes.description: Specifies whether an entry for DirectAccess connectivity appears when the user clicks the Networking notification area icon.

nodes.name: SupportEmail
nodes.description: Specifies the e-mail address to be used when sending the log files that are generated by NCA to the network administrator.

nodes.name: DetectBlockedDriversPolicy
nodes.description: This setting exists only for backward compatibility, and isn't valid for this version of Windows.

nodes.name: DetectDeprecatedCOMComponentFailuresPolicy
nodes.description: This setting exists only for backward compatibility, and isn't valid for this version of Windows.

nodes.name: DetectDeprecatedComponentFailuresPolicy
nodes.description: This setting exists only for backward compatibility, and isn't valid for this version of Windows.

nodes.name: DetectInstallFailuresPolicy
nodes.description: This setting exists only for backward compatibility, and isn't valid for this version of Windows.

nodes.name: DetectUndetectedInstallersPolicy
nodes.description: This setting exists only for backward compatibility, and isn't valid for this version of Windows.

nodes.name: DetectUpdateFailuresPolicy
nodes.description: This setting exists only for backward compatibility, and isn't valid for this version of Windows.

nodes.name: DisablePcaUIPolicy
nodes.description: This policy setting configures the Program Compatibility Assistant (PCA) to diagnose failures with application and driver compatibility.

nodes.name: SamNGCKeyROCAValidation
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure how domain controllers handle Windows Hello for Business (WHfB) keys that are vulnerable to the "Return of Coppersmith's attack" (ROCA) vulnerability.

nodes.name: BetterWhenConnected
nodes.description: This policy setting allows users who are connected to the Internet to access and search troubleshooting content that's hosted on Microsoft content servers.

nodes.name: ScriptedDiagnosticsExecutionPolicy
nodes.description: This policy setting allows users to access and run the troubleshooting tools that are available in the Troubleshooting Control Panel and to run the troubleshooting wizard to troubleshoot problems on…

nodes.name: ScriptedDiagnosticsSecurityPolicy
nodes.description: This policy setting determines whether scripted diagnostics will execute diagnostic packages that are signed by untrusted publishers.

nodes.name: ScheduledDiagnosticsExecutionPolicy
nodes.description: Determines whether scheduled diagnostics will run to proactively detect and resolve system problems. If you enable this policy setting, you must choose an execution level.

nodes.name: AccessDeniedConfiguration
nodes.description: This policy setting specifies the message that users see when they're denied access to a file or folder. You can customize the Access Denied message to include additional text and links.

nodes.name: CentralClassificationList
nodes.description: This policy setting controls which set of properties is available for classifying files on affected computers.

nodes.name: EnableManualUX
nodes.description: This policy setting controls whether the Classification tab is displayed in the Properties dialog box in File Explorer.

nodes.name: EnableShellAccessCheck
nodes.description: This Group Policy Setting should be set on Windows clients to enable access-denied assistance for all file types.

nodes.name: 6to4_Router_Name
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to specify a 6to4 relay name for a 6to4 host. A 6to4 relay is used as a default gateway for IPv6 network traffic sent by the 6to4 host.

nodes.name: 6to4_Router_Name_Resolution_Interval
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to specify the interval at which the relay name is resolved.

nodes.name: 6to4_State
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure 6to4, an address assignment and router-to-router automatic tunneling technology that's used to provide unicast IPv6 connectivity between IPv6 sites and…

nodes.name: IPHTTPS_ClientState
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure IP-HTTPS, a tunneling technology that uses the HTTPS protocol to provide IP connectivity to a remote network.

nodes.name: IP_Stateless_Autoconfiguration_Limits_State
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure IP Stateless Autoconfiguration Limits.

nodes.name: ISATAP_Router_Name
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to specify a router name or Internet Protocol version 4 (IPv4) address for an ISATAP router.

nodes.name: ISATAP_State
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure Intra-Site Automatic Tunnel Addressing Protocol (ISATAP), an address-to-router and host-to-host, host-to-router and router-to-host automatic tunneling…

nodes.name: Teredo_Client_Port
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to select the UDP port the Teredo client will use to send packets. If you leave the default of 0, the operating system will select a port (recommended).

nodes.name: Teredo_Default_Qualified
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to set Teredo to be ready to communicate, a process referred to as qualification. By default, Teredo enters a dormant state when not in use.

nodes.name: Teredo_Refresh_Rate
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure the Teredo refresh rate.

nodes.name: Teredo_Server_Name
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to specify the name of the Teredo server. This server name will be used on the Teredo client computer where this policy setting is applied.

nodes.name: Teredo_State
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure Teredo, an address assignment and automatic tunneling technology that provides unicast IPv6 connectivity across the IPv4 Internet.

nodes.name: Windows_Scaling_Heuristics_State
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to configure Window Scaling Heuristics.

nodes.name: SetCost
nodes.description: This policy setting configures the cost of Wireless LAN (WLAN) connections on the local machine. If this policy setting is enabled, a drop-down list box presenting possible cost values will be active.

nodes.name: SetPINEnforced
nodes.description: This policy applies to Wireless Display connections. This policy means that the use of a PIN for pairing to Wireless Display devices is required rather than optional.

nodes.name: SetPINPreferred
nodes.description: This policy applies to Wireless Display connections. This policy changes the preference order of the pairing methods.

nodes.name: AllowActionCenterNotifications
nodes.description: This policy is deprecated.

nodes.name: AllowCortanaAboveLock
nodes.description: This policy setting determines whether or not the user can interact with Cortana using speech while the system is locked.

nodes.name: AllowToasts
nodes.description: Specifies whether to allow toast notifications above the device lock screen. Most restricted value is 0.

nodes.name: ConfigureAudioOnLockScreen
nodes.description: This policy will allow the audio above lock screen to be managed by IT admins and allow apps like digital signage to play audio above lock screen without having a user signed on.

allowedValues.description: No audio playback or recording on lock screen (aside from OS defined exceptions).
Audio playback allowed on lock screen. Audio recording isn't allowed.
Audio playback and recording allowed on lock screen.

nodes.name: AllowAddingNonMicrosoftAccountsManually
nodes.description: Specifies whether user is allowed to add non-MSA email accounts. Most restricted value is 0. Note This policy will only block UI/UX-based methods for adding non-Microsoft accounts.

nodes.name: AllowMicrosoftAccountConnection
nodes.description: Specifies whether the user is allowed to use an MSA account for non-email related connection authentication and services. Most restricted value is 0.

nodes.name: AllowMicrosoftAccountSignInAssistant
nodes.description: Allows IT Admins the ability to disable the Microsoft Account Sign-In Assistant (wlidsvc) NT service.

nodes.name: RestrictToEnterpriseDeviceAuthenticationOnly
nodes.description: This setting determines whether to only allow enterprise device authentication for the Microsoft Account Sign-in Assistant service (wlidsvc).

allowedValues.description: Allow both device and user authentication. Don't block user authentication.
Only allow device authentication. Block user authentication.

nodes.name: ApprovedInstallationSites
nodes.description: This policy setting determines which ActiveX installation sites standard users in your organization can use to install ActiveX controls on their computers.

nodes.name: TurnOffApplicationFootprint
nodes.description: This policy controls the state of Application Footprint. Application Footprint monitors the sampled collection of registry and file usage to help diagnose compatibility problems.

nodes.name: TurnOffInstallTracing
nodes.description: This policy controls the state of Install Tracing. Install Tracing is a mechanism that tracks application installs to help diagnose compatibility problems.

nodes.name: TurnOffWin32AppBackup
nodes.description: This policy controls the state of the compatibility scan for backed up applications. The compatibility scan for backed up applications evaluates for compatibility problems in installed applications.

nodes.name: AllowMicrosoftAccountsToBeOptional
nodes.description: This policy setting lets you control whether Microsoft accounts are optional for packaged Microsoft Store apps that require an account to sign in.

nodes.name: AllowAppVClient
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to enable or disable Microsoft Application Virtualization (App-V) feature. Reboot is needed for disable to take effect.

nodes.name: AllowDynamicVirtualization
nodes.description: Enables Dynamic Virtualization of supported shell extensions, browser helper objects, and ActiveX controls.

nodes.name: AllowPackageCleanup
nodes.description: Enables automatic cleanup of appv packages that were added after Windows 10 anniversary release.

nodes.name: AllowPackageScripts
nodes.description: Enables scripts defined in the package manifest of configuration files that should run.

nodes.name: AllowPublishingRefreshUX
nodes.description: Enables a UX to display to the user when a publishing refresh is performed on the client.

nodes.name: AllowReportingServer
nodes.description: Reporting Server URL: Displays the URL of reporting server. Reporting Time: When the client data should be reported to the server. Acceptable range is 0~23, corresponding to the 24 hours in a day.

nodes.name: AllowRoamingFileExclusions
nodes.description: Specifies the file paths relative to %userprofile% that don't roam with a user's profile. Example usage: /FILEEXCLUSIONLIST='desktop;my pictures'.

nodes.name: AllowRoamingRegistryExclusions
nodes.description: Specifies the registry paths that don't roam with a user profile. Example usage: /REGISTRYEXCLUSIONLIST=software\classes;software\clients.

nodes.name: AllowStreamingAutoload
nodes.description: Specifies how new packages should be loaded automatically by App-V on a specific computer.

nodes.name: ClientCoexistenceAllowMigrationmode
nodes.description: Migration mode allows the App-V client to modify shortcuts and FTA's for packages created using a previous version of App-V.

nodes.name: IntegrationAllowRootGlobal
nodes.description: Specifies the location where symbolic links are created to the current version of a per-user published package. Shortcuts, file type associations, etc. are created pointing to this path.

nodes.name: IntegrationAllowRootUser
nodes.description: Specifies the location where symbolic links are created to the current version of a globally published package. Shortcuts, file type associations, etc. are created pointing to this path.

nodes.name: PublishingAllowServer1
nodes.description: Publishing Server Display Name: Displays the name of publishing server. Publishing Server URL: Displays the URL of publishing server.

nodes.name: PublishingAllowServer2
nodes.description: Publishing Server Display Name: Displays the name of publishing server. Publishing Server URL: Displays the URL of publishing server.

nodes.name: PublishingAllowServer3
nodes.description: Publishing Server Display Name: Displays the name of publishing server. Publishing Server URL: Displays the URL of publishing server.

nodes.name: PublishingAllowServer4
nodes.description: Publishing Server Display Name: Displays the name of publishing server. Publishing Server URL: Displays the URL of publishing server.

nodes.name: PublishingAllowServer5
nodes.description: Publishing Server Display Name: Displays the name of publishing server. Publishing Server URL: Displays the URL of publishing server.

nodes.name: StreamingAllowCertificateFilterForClient_SSL
nodes.description: Specifies the path to a valid certificate in the certificate store.

nodes.name: StreamingAllowHighCostLaunch
nodes.description: This setting controls whether virtualized applications are launched on Windows 8 machines connected via a metered network connection (e.g. 4G).

nodes.name: StreamingAllowLocationProvider
nodes.description: Specifies the CLSID for a compatible implementation of the IAppvPackageLocationProvider interface.

nodes.name: StreamingAllowPackageInstallationRoot
nodes.description: Specifies directory where all new applications and updates will be installed.

nodes.name: StreamingAllowPackageSourceRoot
nodes.description: Overrides source location for downloading package content.

nodes.name: StreamingAllowReestablishmentInterval
nodes.description: Specifies the number of seconds between attempts to reestablish a dropped session.

nodes.name: StreamingAllowReestablishmentRetries
nodes.description: Specifies the number of times to retry a dropped session.

nodes.name: StreamingSharedContentStoreMode
nodes.description: Specifies that streamed package contents won't be saved to the local hard disk.

nodes.name: StreamingSupportBranchCache
nodes.description: If enabled, the App-V client will support BrancheCache compatible HTTP streaming. If BranchCache support isn't desired, this should be disabled.

nodes.name: StreamingVerifyCertificateRevocationList
nodes.description: Verifies Server certificate revocation status before streaming using HTTPS.

nodes.name: VirtualComponentsAllowList
nodes.description: Specifies a list of process paths (may contain wildcards) which are candidates for using virtual components (shell extensions, browser helper objects, etc).

nodes.name: DefaultAssociationsConfiguration
nodes.description: This policy allows an administrator to set default file type and protocol associations.

nodes.name: EnableAppUriHandlers
nodes.description: This policy setting determines whether Windows supports web-to-app linking with app URI handlers.

nodes.name: AllowAllTrustedApps
nodes.description: This policy setting allows you to manage the installation of trusted line-of-business (LOB) or developer-signed packaged Microsoft Store apps.

nodes.name: AllowAppStoreAutoUpdate
nodes.description: Specifies whether automatic update of apps from Microsoft Store are allowed. Most restricted value is 0.

nodes.name: AllowAutomaticAppArchiving
nodes.description: This policy setting controls whether the system can archive infrequently used apps. If you enable this policy setting, then the system will periodically check for and archive infrequently used apps.

nodes.name: AllowDeveloperUnlock
nodes.description: Allows or denies development of Microsoft Store applications and installing them directly from an IDE. If you enable this setting and enable the "Allow all trusted apps to install" Group Policy, you…

nodes.name: AllowGameDVR
nodes.description: Windows Game Recording and Broadcasting. This setting enables or disables the Windows Game Recording and Broadcasting features. If you disable this setting, Windows Game Recording won't be allowed.

nodes.name: AllowSharedUserAppData
nodes.description: Manages a Windows app's ability to share data between users who have installed the app. If you enable this policy, a Windows app can share app data with other instances of that app.

allowedValues.description: Prevented/not allowed, but Microsoft Edge downloads book files to a per-user folder for each user.

Allowed. Microsoft Edge downloads book files into a shared folder. For this policy to work correctly, you must also enable the Allow a Windows app to share application data between users group policy. Also, the users must be signed in with a school or work account.

nodes.name: AllowStore
nodes.description: This policy is deprecated.

nodes.name: AllowedNonAdminPackageFamilyNameRules
nodes.description: Allowed package family names for non-Administrator user Windows app package installation.

nodes.name: ApplicationRestrictions

nodes.name: BlockNonAdminUserInstall
nodes.description: Manages non-Administrator users' ability to install Windows app packages. If you enable this policy, non-Administrators will be unable to initiate installation of Windows app packages.

allowedValues.description: Disabled. All users will be able to initiate installation of Windows app packages.
Enabled. Non-administrator users won't be able to initiate installation of Windows app packages.

nodes.name: ConfigureMSIXAuthenticationAuthorizedDomains
nodes.description: This policy setting determines whether an EntraID OAuth token will be included in HTTPS communications to a specified fully qualified domain name for performing an MSIX streaming installation.

nodes.name: DisableStoreOriginatedApps
nodes.description: Disable turns off the launch of all apps from the Microsoft Store that came pre-installed or were downloaded. Apps won't be updated. Your Store will also be disabled. Enable turns all of it back on.

allowedValues.description: Disabled. Users will be able to install MSIX packages from any zone except for Untrusted.
Enabled. Users will be able to install MSIX packages according to the configuration for each zone.

nodes.name: EnableMsixSmartScreenCheck
nodes.description: This policy controls whether Microsoft SmartScreen check is performed when installing MSIX packages from specific URL zones.

allowedValues.description: Disabled. Microsoft SmartScreen won't be consulted before installing a package.
Enabled. The package URI will be evaluated with Microsoft SmartScreen before installation. This check is only done for packages that come from the internet.

nodes.name: LaunchAppAfterLogOn
nodes.description: List of semi-colon delimited Package Family Names of Windows apps. Listed Windows apps are to be launched after logon.

nodes.name: MSIAllowUserControlOverInstall
nodes.description: This policy setting permits users to change installation options that typically are available only to system administrators.

nodes.name: MSIAlwaysInstallWithElevatedPrivileges
nodes.description: This policy setting directs Windows Installer to use elevated permissions when it installs any program on the system. If you enable this policy setting, privileges are extended to all programs.

nodes.name: RemoveDefaultMicrosoftStorePackages

nodes.name: RequirePrivateStoreOnly

allowedValues.description: Allow both public and Private store.

nodes.name: RestrictAppDataToSystemVolume

nodes.name: ScheduleForceRestartForUpdateFailures
nodes.description: To ensure apps are up-to-date, this policy allows the admins to set a recurring or one time date to restart apps whose update failed due to the app being in use allowing the update to be applied.

nodes.name: DoNotPreserveZoneInformation

nodes.name: HideZoneInfoMechanism

nodes.name: NotifyAntivirusPrograms

nodes.name: AccountLogonLogoff_AuditAccountLockout

nodes.name: AccountLogonLogoff_AuditGroupMembership

nodes.name: AccountLogonLogoff_AuditIPsecMainMode
